jobs.title: Operations Manager | NYC
jobs.description:
About Blank Street

At Blank Street, we’re on a mission to become the defining food and beverage brand of our generation. From the very beginning, we’ve set out to add a spark to ordinary experiences through elevated products, attention-to-detail, and a commitment to making every moment memorable. We’re motivated by the millions of customers we serve across cities, and know that our potential is unlimited. It all starts with our people and their commitment to make magic happen each and every day.

Like the sound of this? Keep reading.

Start Something Extraordinary…

As an Operations Manager at Blank Street, you are the ultimate leader of an entire area of 5+ stores and the General Managers who lead them.

That means your greatest responsibility is growing people. You will hire, coach and develop an A* team of GMs, helping them become confident leaders who build engaged, high-performing teams across our stores.
You are also the strategic mind behind your stores: you will own your area's PnL and decide how to plan, prioritize and follow through, so your stores get better day by day. In a fast-moving and constantly evolving business, you will create clarity, build capability, and foster a culture of accountability, hospitality and continuous improvement.

You'll report to the Director of Operations and work closely with the rest of our Field Leadership team. Together, you'll help scale the next generation of leaders while driving an exceptional experience for both our teams and our customers.

What You'll Own

Be Our Ultimate Hospitality Leader

• Make the standards stick: Coach your GMs to build the systems, behaviors and processes that keep our hospitality standards high every shift, whether you're in the store or not.

• Hold the bar: Check standards across your area through regular store visits and data, and hold GMs accountable for closing gaps fast.

• Jump in where it counts: Take an active role in turning around struggling stores and launching new stores in your area.

Run a Tight PnL

• Plan for demand: Take quarterly sales forecasts from HQ, translate them store by store and make sure every GM knows what's coming (growth, slowdowns, seasonality, new openings nearby).

• Build the labor plan: Set labor targets a quarter out, including headcount and transfers between stores, and coach GMs to build rotas against them.

• Calibrate inventory: Help GMs calibrate inventory to forecast demand, and set clear guardrails so no store is badly overstocked or running short.

Build and Develop an A-Team

• Develop your GMs: Grow GMs into future leaders through our training pathways, regular 1:1s and direct feedback.

• Own the talent pipeline: Calibrate hiring and promotion decisions across your area and set quarterly succession targets from barista to GM, so every store has its next leader ready.

• Build an area-wide culture: Turn your stores into one team that shares what works and backs each other, with a culture that's distinctly Blank Street: fast-moving, high-energy, collaborative and fun.

Operate Strategically

• Know your numbers inside out: Master your stores' KPIs and PnL, and set clear priorities for your area every week and every quarter.

• Make sure every store has a plan: Work with each GM to build a plan for their store, then stay close as they carry it out and push the numbers in the right direction.

• Land change and innovation: Roll out new initiatives across your area, from menu launches to tech tools. That means clear comms, hands-on training and real buy-in from your teams, then tracking adoption until it sticks.

Who We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of leadership experience in hospitality, retail, or another fast-growing consumer business.

• Experience leading multiple locations (3-10) and developing the managers who run them.

• Passionate about hospitality: you love creating exceptional customer and employee experiences, and care about setting the bar high in every store you’ve managed.

• Commercial thinker: you have strong operational and financial judgment. You read the data (P&L, KPI dashboards) and know what to do next.

• People leader: you have developed managers in the past and are able to hire an A* team, coach, make decisions and lead through change.

• Strategic planner: you know how to plan a quarter ahead and how to turn priorities into plans your GMs can act on.

• Excellent communicator: you know how to cut through the noise and are sharp in writing (Slack, Notion, email) and confident in speech (area meetings, workshops).

Availability Requirements

Able to travel regularly between stores within your market.

Full Time: 50 hours per week, 5 days of availability required and must be available to work 2 peak days (usually weekend days, weekend as described as Friday, Saturday, Sunday)

Benefits & Perks

• $90,000 - $120,000 annual base salary Blank Street believes this salary range is accurate for this role in New York City at the time of posting. Final compensation will depend on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a competitive total rewards package, which may include benefits, paid time off, and other perks. The posted salary range may be updated from time to time.

• 15 days of paid annual leave (on top of company-observed holidays and sick time)

• Three health plan options, with full coverage available for two employee-only tiers.

• Commuter benefits

• Parental leave

• Bereavement leave

• Exclusive access to our coveted Regulars program - yes, that means free coffee, matcha and more!

• Regular social outings with the team

• Free Blank Street swag

jobs.title: Web Program Manager (PM)
jobs.description:
Location: [SF Bay Area, NYC, or Los Angeles] (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)

Impact

This role sits at the intersection of web, marketing, and execution. You’ll act as a hands-on partner to the client, supporting go-to-market launches by translating strategy into high-quality web experiences and deliverables.

Operating within defined scopes to move work forward, you will conduct research, shape web recommendations, and translate marketing and product needs into clear briefs and actionable web workstreams. You’ll ensure that web is effectively positioned within the broader marketing funnel, from acquisition through engagement. You play a critical role in helping the client make informed decisions about how web supports launches, from structure and content to performance and measurement, while keeping work organized, prioritized, and moving.

Key Responsibilities

Web Marketing & Execution

• Translate marketing initiatives into effective web experiences, including landing pages, campaign pages, and other digital experiences
• Develop clear briefs and requirements that translate marketing, product, audience, and brand needs into actionable web work
• Partner across design, content, development, and other stakeholders to move work from brief through execution
• Support decisions around site structure, content types, and user journeys, including landing page strategy, SEO considerations, and content formats
• Ensure web experiences align with broader campaign and product launch goals

Go-to-Market Support

• Support product and campaign launches through targeted tasks, including research, audits, recommendations, planning, and execution
• Conduct analysis on customer journeys, the competitive landscape, and SEO opportunities
• Understand how audience, product, brand, and campaign priorities come together across the web experience
• Contribute to shaping how web fits into the full marketing funnel

Project Management & Prioritization

• Manage day-to-day workflow, balancing multiple incoming requests with varying levels of urgency
• Triage and prioritize work effectively, making informed tradeoffs when needed
• Maintain organization across tasks, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables
• Communicate progress clearly and proactively
• Translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements, next steps, and executable workstreams

Analytics & Optimization

• Use data to validate decisions and inform recommendations
• Analyze site performance metrics, including engagement, conversion, and traffic behavior
• Contribute to reporting and dashboards to track performance and impact

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Partner closely with the client, maintaining strong alignment and communication
• Check in proactively on direction and approach rather than working in isolation
• Translate between teams with different priorities, inputs, and areas of expertise
• Navigate different personalities and working styles with strong emotional intelligence
• Read the room and adapt communication and execution style accordingly
• Provide cross-functional partners with the context and direction needed to move work forward effectively

What Success Looks Like

• Web work is delivered accurately, efficiently, and with strong attention to detail
• You demonstrate a clear understanding of how web supports marketing and product launches
• You can take an ambiguous initiative and turn it into a clear brief, plan, and executable web workstream
• Cross-functional partners have the context and direction they need to move work forward
• Requests are properly prioritized, with urgency and impact balanced effectively
• You take initiative while staying aligned, proactively checking direction and avoiding missteps
• The client trusts your judgment and sees you as a reliable, thoughtful partner
• Web recommendations are grounded in both marketing strategy and performance data
• You operate independently within your scope without needing excessive direction
• Work is organized, timelines are managed, and nothing falls through the cracks
• You contribute to smarter decisions around site experience, structure, and measurement

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.

Required

• 4–7 years of experience in web marketing, digital marketing, or closely related roles, such as web strategy, web marketing management, digital experience, or marketing operations ideally in a management consulting setting
• Experience developing briefs, requirements, and project plans for web initiatives
• Experience supporting marketing or product launches and contributing to web strategy and execution, without necessarily owning full programs end-to-end
• Strong understanding of how web fits into the full marketing funnel, including acquisition, engagement, and conversion, with knowledge of:Landing page strategySEO fundamentalsContent structure and user journeys
• Experience using data to inform decisions, including familiarity with web analytics, dashboards, and performance metrics such as traffic, engagement, and conversion behavior
• Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple workstreams, especially in environments with shifting or ambiguous priorities
• Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, creative, design, development, or related teams
• Ability to translate inputs from multiple stakeholders into clear, actionable web requirements and workstreams
• Ability to operate with autonomy within a defined scope while proactively aligning with stakeholders
• Bachelor's degree

Preferred

• Familiarity with SEO basics and how they integrate into web content workflows
• Consumer hardware, e-commerce, or devices web marketing background
• Experience with project management tools
• Content strategy experience, including educational guides, product exploration, or editorial calendars
• Agency coordination experience

Compensation & Benefits

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

• Base Salary: $124,400–$129,500. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.

• Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

• College savings and student loan repayment programs

• Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

• Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

jobs.description:
A BETTER BUILT WORLD https://www.miter.com/resources/a-better-built-world/

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.



For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.



That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical https://www.miter.com/customer-story/marathon-electrical-contractors/, W.J. O’Neil https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GNExtmeHcSg, and Truebeck Construction http://truebeck.com/ are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.



This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.







ABOUT THE TEAM & HOW WE WORK

As Engineering Manager for Financials at Miter, you will build both a team and a product line from the ground up. This is a player-coach role where you will lead a small, growing engineering pod while remaining one of the strongest engineers on it, taking new Financials products from zero to one on top of Miter's construction payroll and HR platform. This team will act as a startup within Miter, moving quickly and working directly with customers to build great products.

You will grow a small team into a full Financials pod, hiring the engineers you will lead, and you will expand the product from expenses, reimbursements, and per diems into enterprise-ready financial systems. You will own the roadmap, the architecture, and the quality bar for systems where correctness is not negotiable: money movement, ledgers, reconciliation. You will work directly with our CEO and with our earliest Financials customers, discovering what needs to be built as you build it.

There is no playbook for this product yet. You will write it, on a greenfield surface backed by a company with thousands of customers and real distribution behind it, in an industry that has run on the same outdated software for forty years. You will have a direct impact on how contractors across the country manage their money, ultimately helping them build a better built world.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and hire the Financials team: grow a small engineering pod, and find, attract, and hire the engineers you will lead, then onboard, coach, and run performance for them.

 - Ship 0->1 Financials products: take multiple new experiences from zero to one, expanding from expenses, reimbursements, and per diems into enterprise-ready AP, AR, and accounting for contractors.

 - Stay hands-on as a player-coach: operate as one of the strongest engineers on the team on the hardest problems, setting the technical bar through code and design rather than from the sidelines.

 - Own delivery and technical direction: set the roadmap, architecture, and quality bar for Financials, and own reliability for business-critical systems.

 - Partner directly with the CEO and early customers: work closely with our CEO and with Miter's earliest Financials customers to discover what we need to build as we build it.

 - Move fast without mortgaging the future: default to speed on an ambiguous, greenfield surface while making architecture and product decisions that hold up long term.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A significant hands-on engineering career at senior or staff level, now moving into or early in engineering management. This is a first or second management role, not a junior-overall profile.

 - Experience taking 0->1 products or new product lines from scratch to shipped, not only scaling mature ones.

 - Experience in a genuinely complex, high-correctness domain such as fintech, payments, accounting, or payroll, where getting the details wrong has real consequences.

 - The ability to design and evolve correctness-critical transactional systems at scale: money movement, ledgers, reconciliation. Strong enough as an engineer to be among the best on the team when called on.

 - A track record of attracting and hiring strong engineers, and of raising a small team's level through direct feedback and technical mentorship.

 - Decisiveness under ambiguity, and credibility both with executives and directly with demanding customers.

 - Nice to have: vertical SaaS, construction or field-services, or workforce and payroll experience; direct AP/AR, general-ledger or accounting-product experience; comfort with the latest AI developer tooling; a good eye for UX.




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Recruiter Screen

 - Hiring Manager Interview

 - Technical Interview

 - Virtual Onsite (Values & System Design)




OUR BENEFITS:

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.

 - Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan:  Company-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.

 - Flexible PTO: Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.

 - Parental Leave: Generous 16-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.

 - Learning & Development: We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development. 

 - Office Extras: Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in-office Mitosaurs.

 - Community: Company-wide and team-specific off-sites per year.
   
   


HYBRID VS. REMOTE APPROACH:

We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as hybrid, our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach. 



Otherwise, for roles listed as remote or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company-wide and team specific off-sites! 




JOIN OUR TALENT COMMUNITY

Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? Apply to our Talent Community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/miter/form/talent-community-form, and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience!




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY:

Miter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.




USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS:

Miter uses AI-assisted tools as part of our hiring process to help our recruiting team manage and review applications more efficiently. We want to be transparent about how this works.

What the AI does: When you apply to a role at Miter, an AI tool may review your application against the specific qualifications and requirements posted for that job. This tool identifies whether your experience appears to meet, partially meet, or not meet each stated requirement, and it provides supporting evidence from your application for every assessment it makes.

What the AI does not do: The AI does not make hiring decisions. It does not reject, advance, or rank candidates on its own, and it does not assign you a numerical score. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team, who makes the final call on whether you move forward. The AI is a tool that helps our team prioritize their time across a high volume of applications. It is not a substitute for human judgment.

What information it uses: The tool evaluates the application materials you submit (your resume and any other application content) against role-specific criteria our team has defined. It does not pull information from external sources such as social media or professional networking profiles, and personal identifying information is removed from your materials before any AI review takes place.

Human oversight: Our recruiting team periodically reviews how these tools are performing to check for unintended patterns in outcomes, and we retain the ability to override any AI-generated assessment at any time.

jobs.title: Security Associate - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Schedule (Open Availability Highly Preferred):

• Mon, Tues 5PM-1:30AM Fri-Sun 7:30PM-4AM

Pay Range: $19 hourly

About Carvana

At Carvana, we believe buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks — so we're rewriting the playbook. Yes, we're the vending machine people. Yes, we built that on purpose. And yes, we're just getting started.

We're looking for people who want to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit shows up in everything we do — every day, our passion and creativity drive the kind of innovation that moves an industry. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not letting up. Want the full story? Check it out here.

About the team and position

Our Safe & Secure team is the heartbeat of every Carvana location. You're the people we trust to protect our associates, our customers, and the thousands of vehicles that flow through our gates every day. Rain, shine, ice, or 110° heat — the mission doesn't change, and neither does the standard.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role. We bring the strategy; you bring the hustle. From clearing snow during a winter storm to running heat-safety protocols in July, you'll be the reason our site stays open, safe, and moving. Some days you'll be at the gate — the literal face of Carvana to every associate, vendor, and visitor walking through it. Other days, you'll be out on the lot scanning vehicles, knocking out safety audits, or restocking the supplies that keep this place humming.

You won't just monitor a perimeter — you'll own it. That means spotting hazards before they become incidents, building real relationships with the folks on site, and stepping up when something needs your attention. You'll be trained and trusted to act in emergencies, partner with our Inspection Center and Logistics teams, and feed sharp, accurate intel back to your Safe & Secure leadership. Hourly position, reporting to your Safe & Secure Functional Lead or Manager.

What you’ll be doing

• Lead with a service-first mindset in every interaction.

• Live the Carvana values — and make sure they're felt by everyone you work with.

• Be the face of Carvana at the gate for associates, vendors, and visitors.

• Communicate like a pro — clear, calm, active listener, no missed signals.

• Use our Unified Security Platform to monitor live cameras, review footage, and investigate intrusion alerts so nothing on site catches us off guard.

• When things get hot, keep it cool. De-escalate, win with partners, and remember — we're all in this together.

• Run point at the gate using the Safe & Secure App (SAS App) and RFID tech, enforcing ingress/egress procedures every single time.

• Manage and document vehicle movement through the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.

• Show up when the team needs you. You'll be trained and certified in first aid, CPR, and AED — and we expect you to use it when the moment calls for it.

• Know our emergency protocols cold so you can act decisively when seconds count.

• Keep the site operational in any weather — snow removal in winter, heat-safety protocols in summer, no excuses, no shortcuts.

• Drive a safety-first culture by spotting environmental hazards, running safety audits, and reinforcing best practices with the people around you.

• Scan thousands of vehicles a day to keep operational flow tight — between mobile rover tech and manual handheld scans, every car gets accounted for.

• Cover ground. This role involves serious walking to reach restricted or hard-to-access areas of the lot.

• Run vehicle location research and deliver clean, detailed reports to leadership when operational questions come up.

Key Metrics:

• Unit Loss Rate versus Plan

• Safe & Secure App Execution

• Inventory Control/Accuracy and Tracking

• Safety Incident Performance

What you should know/have

• 1–2 years in a customer service environment

• Strong verbal and written communication

• A track record of solid decision-making in a complex, fast-moving environment

• Ability to build strong working relationships and connect with people quickly

• Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks at once in a fast-paced setting

• Ability to handle conflict in a positive, productive way

We’d love it if you also have

• Familiarity with CCTV, RFID, Card Access, or other Safe & Secure technology

• Previous experience supporting an OSHA / Safety Team program

• Experience with crisis prevention and/or response plans

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-time hourly position with a competitive wage

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401(k) with company match

• A stack of perks — student loan support, vehicle discounts, pet benefits, and a lot more

• A wellness program built to keep you healthy, physically and mentally

• Real opportunities to grow your skills and share what you know across the org

• A promote-from-within culture with a startup feel — career paths can move fast around here

• A seat at one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• This position is designated as a safety-sensitive position

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; the majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet, and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance

• Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include, but is not limited to, face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

• Requires frequent driving and computer data entry

• Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance

• The facility is a 24/7 operation, and gates must be manned at all times

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any protected category.

Please note that this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in SQL, Python, and data visualization, with a strong track record of delivering self-service reporting platforms, scalable ETL pipelines, and high-quality dashboards that enable data-driven decision making. In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex data needs into clear, actionable solutions while upholding engineering best practices in architecture, performance, and data quality.

PRIMARY DUTIES:

• Triage requests for people data and ad hoc reports, prioritize requests, and effectively communicate appropriate delivery expectations.

• Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to create dashboards that display meaningful and actionable key performance indicators (KPIs).

• Create visualizations from which leaders can easily draw insights and recommendations.

• Build and automate easy-to-use, self-service reports and dashboards.

• Provide direction and coaching to end users on how to use and interpret metrics.

• Document reporting requirements with partners by collaborating with relevant Data Analytics team members on iterations and changes to core dashboards and solutions.

• Pull, organize, and analyze relevant data from multiple sources using tools such as Tableau, VS Code, and Jupyter Notebook, and programming languages such as SQL and Python.

• Partner and align with cross-functional teams including Data Engineering and Data Science, executing best practices in data gathering, pipeline design, and analytics.

• Audit data integrity, investigate concerns, and establish processes to streamline and improve data quality.

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse internal and external sources.

• Improve the performance of ETL tasks through good architecture and code optimization.

• Be part of the on-call team and monitor and address operational issues to ensure reliability and uptime of data systems.

• Stay current with emerging trends in data engineering, analytics tooling, and cloud-based data platforms.

COMPETENCY:

• Experience with Apache Hive and Presto for large-scale distributed query processing.

• Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and data science workflows.

• Experience with large-scale data migration projects, including requirements gathering, pipeline design, and operational support.

• Mentoring experience with junior engineers and analysts.

jobs.title: Manager of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Position Summary

STR is seeking an innovative and strategic financial leader to serve as Sr. Manager of FP&A. Reporting to the Director of FP&A, the Sr. Manager will be responsible for all aspects of financial planning and analysis, including annual and long-term company-wide budgeting, forecasting, rate development, investment analysis, incentive compensation, and supporting executive-level reporting.

This is a transformative role for an experienced FP&A leader passionate about leveraging technology—particularly AI and advanced analytics—to drive business insight, operational efficiency, and scalable growth. The Sr. Manager will operate as a key advisor to the Director of FP&A and Division Finance Leads, ensuring STR’s finance function exceeds the requirements typical of highly regulated and rapidly growing organizations.

We are seeking a leader who brings a high degree of financial rigor, governance discipline, and a forward-looking mindset—someone comfortable operating within the robust standards and expectations of highly complex, audit-intensive organizations.

We support flexible work arrangements for this role, including remote work within the U.S.. For candidates located near our Woburn, MA office, a hybrid schedule is preferred to enable effective partnership, relationship building, and cross-functional collaboration.

What you will do:

• Strategic Leadership: Shape the future of the finance function by introducing best-in-class processes and tools for automation, efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

• AI & Analytics Transformation: Champion adoption of AI and machine learning techniques within FP&A to enhance forecasting, scenario modeling, and data-driven decision making. Evaluate and adopt emerging tools in financial planning, reporting, and analysis that leverage AI or predictive analytics capabilities.

• Planning & Forecasting: Oversee annual operating plans (AOP), monthly forecasts, and long-range (LRP) strategic planning. Ensure tight alignment among operational, financial, and strategic objectives, and develop models explaining key drivers of business performance.

• Rate Strategy & Analysis: Develop and refine indirect rate strategies to ensure competitive, compliant, and forward-looking cost structures consistent with contract requirements and company strategy.

• Investment & Incentive Analysis: Lead financial analysis and tracking for R&D, capital, facility, bid & proposal, and new product development investments. Partner with HR on incentive compensation plans, including performance modeling and target setting. Provide actionable analysis to inform strategic investment decisions.

• KPI Development & Performance Oversight: Lead the design and implementation of enterprise KPIs and financial metrics that provide investor-grade transparency and integrity, supporting executive- and Board-level decision-making with timely insights.

• Executive & Board Communication: Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and actionable financial insights to the CFO, executive leadership, and Board of Directors, ensuring clarity and accuracy consistent with external stakeholder and boardroom expectations.

• Governance & Financial Controls: Establish and maintain rigorous financial controls, policies, and reporting standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and readiness for external audits and Board oversight.

• Team Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing FP&A team. Build talent pipelines and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate across STR to influence strategic decisions and drive data-driven business outcomes as a trusted advisor to operations and functional leaders.

Who you are:

• This position requires the ability to obtain a US government security clearance, for which US citizenship is needed by the US Government

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or related field required; MBA or Master’s preferred.

• Minimum 10+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience in the defense contracting industry.

• Demonstrated leadership within complex, matrixed, and high-growth organizations.

• Expertise with enterprise planning and financial analytics tools; experience implementing or championing emerging technologies such as AI and automation within finance preferred.

• Experience supporting external audits and government compliance (DCAA/DFARS).

• Familiarity with financial reporting, controls, and processes typical of highly regulated environments (e.g., SOX, SEC reporting, Board governance).

• Proven ability to implement and drive process improvements and innovation within FP&A.

• Advanced communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.

• Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving abilities with meticulous attention to detail.

• Ability to obtain a security clearance (U.S. citizenship required by DoD).

Nice to have:

• Change agent mindset; embraces and leads transformation.

• Business partner orientation with a collaborative, positive approach.

• Resilient and adaptable under pressure in a fast-paced and highly regulated business environment.

• Commitment to continuous professional development—self and team.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $180,000.00 to $230,000.00

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

jobs.title: Illinois Leadership Opportunities
jobs.description:
Overview

Green Thumb is proudly on a mission to promote well-being through the power of cannabis. We are looking for individuals at RISE Dispensary who can lead, manage, and inspire a diverse team in driving results and delivering memorable, positive consumer experiences. All dispensary activities related to the customer journey, inventory operations, safety & compliance, and team member experience are under your direction.

Competencies

• Drives Results: Challenges and inspires a team to exceed results expectations. Consistently executes against company strategy, state regulatory requirements and local operations plans.

• Adapts to Change: Communicates the “why” to the team and aligns them with the Green Thumb’s Mission, Vision, Values, Priorities, and Behaviors. Is a change champion who helps the team navigate through change.

• Business Insight: Optimizes outcomes by leveraging data, understanding the story behind the numbers, and translating into behaviors and actions for the team.

• Customer Focus: Leverages data to understand customer needs and acts on it. Improves the consumer journey by increasing efficiency and empowering the team.

• Collaborates: Speaks to people, with actionable and respectful feedback, and coaches' others to work collaboratively. Communicates effectively across multiple channels to keep teams in-the-know.

• Values Differences: Prioritizes building diverse teams with a variety of experiences, perspectives, backgrounds and skills. Serves as role model for fostering an environment where differences are encouraged, valued, and supported.

• Develops Talent: Places a high priority on developing people to drive strong performance and achieve career goals. Takes ownership of the employee life cycle and team’s engagement and professional development.

Responsibilities

Operations

• Deliver direction, oversight, and execution of all dispensary operations. Ensure the dispensary is compliant with security, inventory, and local and state regulations.

• Drive revenue and profit through effective execution of programs, initiatives, and regionalized instore promotions.

• Oversee and manage quality product inventory, financial records, and Seed to Sale compliance.

• Maintain and enforce cash management handling protocols and daily reconciliation.

• Manage effective order & expense management processes aligned with store budgets.

• Conduct monthly audits and scorecard business reviews to identify operational inefficiencies and process improvement opportunities

Experience

• Coach Leaders and Team Members to consistently deliver memorable, positive in-store customer experiences.

• Ensure “Leader on Duty” (LOD) presence is appropriately scheduled throughout the store. Coach Leaders to actively supervise, recognize team members and redirect behaviors during LOD shifts.

• Drive revenue through a seamless omni-channel customer experience and lead teams to deliver a consistent experience across in-store, drive-thru, curbside & delivery.

• Coach leadership team to deliver Loyalty goals, drive customer retention and repeat traffic.

• Serve as a liaison to the local community and support community outreach events and initiatives.

People

• Build and retain a high-performing team through selecting the best talent and effective onboarding, training, and development.

• Inspire a culture of engagement and performance through coaching, feedback, and recognition.

• Motivate dispensary team to exceed revenue targets and key metrics, emphasizing team member behaviors, service techniques and product knowledge.

• Monitor staffing needs and ensure scheduling practices align to store labor goals. Hold team members accountable for accurate timekeeping, schedule compliance, and reliability.

• Develop Leader and Team Member talent and effectively address performance issues on a timely basis.

• Regular, dependable attendance and punctuality.

• Perform other duties as needed.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or comparable business experience

• Supervisory or management experience in a retail setting, specifically with POS business operations.

• Cannabis experience preferred

• Inventory control experience is required

• Meet the scheduling and availability requirements (i.e., ability to work a schedule inclusive of varying shifts such as mornings, days, nights, and weekends) to meet business needs

• Must have reliable, responsible, and dependable attendance

• Must be 21 years or older.

• Must pass any and all required background checks.

• Must possess a valid driver’s license or state ID.

• Must be and remain compliant with all legal and company regulations for working in the industry.

• Must understand and comply with the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of Green Thumb

• Must have a solid understanding of the Cannabis laws, rules and regulations and passion to further their understanding and knowledge of the industry and the laws.

Skills

• Must be proactive, with a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and strong communication and leadership skills.

• Meet timelines consistently and be able to work under pressure effectively.

• Continuously open to constructive, developmental feedback, ability to maintain composure even in difficult situations.

• High interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment, often working cross-functionally.

• Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgment, common sense and resourcefulness.

• Adapts and thrives in a demanding, fast-paced environment

• Possesses a high level of critical thinking.

• Operates with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information and complying with HIPAA requirements.

• Ability to resolve conflict, handle employee and customer complaints, and settle disputes

Additional Requirement

Must have the ability to perform the following tasks for prolonged periods of time (i.e., up to the duration of a workday)

• Move about the dispensary to fulfill work assignments and assist employees and patients and/or customers in various locations of the dispensary

• Remain in a stationary position, if required, up to and including in an office setting, to meet the needs of the business and complete managerial tasks timely

• Converse and communicate with individuals and groups of people directly

• Operate point of sale system, computer, and other office productivity machinery to use online programming and software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications, and email

• Prepare patient and/or customer orders by moving and placing products

• Inspect and receive detailed information, such as patients' and/or customers' dates of birth, in-store or online orders, or inquiries

• Move inventory and materials weighing up to 30 pounds independently

• Position self to move inventory and materials in storage areas

Working Conditions

• Patient and/or customer-facing environment

• Ability to work outdoors in varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions

• Exposure to cannabis and/or allergens that might be present in an environment where cannabis is present and prevalent

Our Mission: To promote well-being through the power of cannabis.

We’re humble—We prefer quiet confidence and don’t shout about our success.
We’re hardworking—We put our heads down and get the job done.
We’re grateful—Working in our industry is a privilege and an act of service.
We’re transparent—Honest and open communication keeps us healthy as an organization.
We’re collaborative—And believe good ideas can come from anywhere.
We have a growth mindset—One that’s grounded in well-being.

At GTI we believe that our corporate community should reflect the communities we serve. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity across race, sex, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, nationality, religion, experience, and thought—not only because it is right but because it makes us better. Our mission—the right to wellness—informs our commitment to champion economic opportunities in communities disproportionately affected by the war on drugs through employment and community involvement. GTI is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace.

We can't wait to meet you.

The pay range is competitive and based on experience, qualifications, and/or location of the role. Positions may be eligible for a discretionary annual incentive program driven by organization and individual performance.

Green Thumb Pay Range

$55,000—$85,000 USD

jobs.title: Account Executive, Sales & Partner Success
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline is looking for a motivated Account Executive to grow and support our drone delivery marketplace in Pea Ridge, AR. This is a field-based role that combines sales and partner success. You will build relationships with local restaurants and retailers, close new partnerships, and help those partners launch and grow on Zipline.

You will own the partner relationship from the first conversation through onboarding, launch, ongoing support, and long-term growth.

What You'll Do

• Map your local territory, prioritize prospective partners, and manage a pipeline to close restaurants monthly and meet your monthly sales quotas.

• Build relationships with local businesses, prospect for new partners, and close sales.

• Learn each partner’s business needs and explain how Zipline delivery can support their customers and operations.

• Guide partners through onboarding and launch, working with internal teams to make sure they are ready to succeed.

• Own ongoing partner success by solving problems, monitoring performance, and identifying opportunities to grow the relationship.

• Coordinate with operations and other internal teams to confirm partner readiness, resolve launch issues, and support a smooth start.

• Train partner staff on the tools and workflows they need to fulfill Zipline orders.

• Keep partner records, pipeline updates, and forecasts current, and share local market insights with the team.

What You'll Bring

• 2+ years of successful sales experience, owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through field sales, cold calling and market mapping.

• Someone who can confidently sell, communicate clearly, and follow through after the deal closes.

• A motivated, organized relationship-builder who enjoys working in the field.

• Someone excited by measurable goals and the opportunity to help launch a new way of delivering goods.

What Else You Need To Know

jobs.title: Mobile Phlebotomist (Queens, NYC) | Temp | $1,000 Bonus
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Sprinter Health, our mission is to reimagine how people access care by bringing high quality care directly into the home.

Using the same technology that powers leading marketplace platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most.

We’ve supported millions of patients across 22 states and consistently maintained a 90+ NPS, reflecting the quality and experience we strive to deliver every day.

Our clinical teams are at the center of making healthcare more accessible, connected, and personal.



Where patient experience isn’t a metric. It’s a standard.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sprinter, you’ll bring healthcare directly to patients in the comfort of their homes. You’ll spend your day on the road providing a variety of preventative and diagnostic services, including blood draws, vitals, height and weight assessments, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and more.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys independence, connecting with patients, and a workday that looks different from a traditional clinic setting.

What We Offer

 - Guaranteed daily hours

 - National Mileage reimbursement, currently $0.76/mile reimbursement starting at mile 31

 - Company paid healthcare premiums

 - 100% 401(k) contribution of 3%

 - Company provided equipment including iPhone, iPad, scrubs, and supplies


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Life as a Sprinter starts before the first patient visit. Your car becomes both your office and your lab on the go, so preparation and organization are everything.

 - Prepare for your day by reviewing your schedule and ensuring you have the proper supplies and PPE.

 - Travel to patients’ homes throughout your assigned service area.

 - Provide scheduled services including blood draws, vitals, height and weight measurements, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and other preventative and diagnostic services.

 - Use your expert phlebotomy skills to make blood draws as comfortable as possible for each patient.

 - Create a warm, welcoming, and professional experience in every patient’s home.

 - Accurately document each patient visit using Sprinter technology.

 - Properly label, handle, and transport specimens for lab drop off or shipment.

 - Manage your time, supplies, and schedule independently as you move from patient to patient throughout the day.


SOUND LIKE YOU?


MASTER OF YOUR CRAFT

 - Do you have exceptional blood draw skills?

 - Have you been the “go to” for hard sticks?

 - Are you confident in drawing blood from a wide range of patients?

 - Are you comfortable learning and performing additional clinical services?


ROAD WARRIOR

 - Do you enjoy a change of scenery during your workday?

 - Are you comfortable spending a significant portion of your day on the road?

 - Are you willing to travel an hour or more to visit patients?

 - Can you comfortably drive before 7:00 a.m. when your first patient is scheduled at 7:00 a.m.?


PATIENT FOCUSED

 - Are you passionate about helping others?

 - Are you kind, empathetic, and an effective communicator?

 - Do you enjoy meeting new people and creating a great patient experience?


SEEN IT ALL BEFORE

 - Are you comfortable providing care in a variety of home environments, recognizing that each patient’s living conditions and standards may be different from your own?

 - Can you remain calm, adaptable, and professional when faced with challenging or unexpected situations?


COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE

 - Do you pride yourself on being reliable, dependable, and trustworthy?

 - Are you solution oriented and able to think critically when challenges arise?

 - Is your mode of transportation as reliable as you are?


TECH PROFICIENT

 - Are you proficient using Apple iPhones and iPads beyond calling and texting?

 - Are you comfortable navigating apps, electronic health records, telehealth platforms, and other digital tools?

 - Can you confidently learn and navigate new technology independently?

If you’re nodding yes, you’re off to a great start. Here are a few more things you’ll need to be successful as a Sprinter.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Strong phlebotomy skills, including experience with challenging sticks

 - Patient facing healthcare experience as a Phlebotomist, Medical Assistant (MA), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) in home preferred

 - Current BLS certification

 - Valid driver’s license, current auto insurance, and personal, reliable vehicle

 - Availability Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.

 - Ability to drive before 7:00 a.m. to arrive at your first scheduled patient on time

jobs.title: Site Launcher
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

As a Site Launcher, you are the on-the-ground point person for bringing new Zipline charging locations and partner sites into service. You turn launch plans into coordinated action: bringing teams together, verifying readiness, resolving blockers, and carrying each assigned site through first deliveries and handoff to ongoing operations.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You will be trusted to run day-to-day site execution without constant direction, lead people who do not report to you, and make sound decisions as conditions change. You will work closely with the Launch Manager on broader planning and major tradeoffs, while owning daily priorities, follow-through, and clear communication from the field. You know when to act independently, when to bring in a functional expert, and when to escalate.

Success means sites are genuinely ready to launch, teams know what comes next, and risks are visible early enough to act.

What You'll Do

• Lead the launch on the ground. Serve as the primary day-to-day coordination point for assigned sites, from pre-launch preparation through launch, early operations, and handoff.

• Turn the plan into action. Maintain site-level launch plans with clear milestones, dependencies, owners, and deadlines. Set daily priorities, run focused check-ins, and follow commitments through to completion.

• Bring teams together. Align infrastructure, permitting, regulatory, flight operations, maintenance, commercial, community engagement, and partner teams around the launch plan. Resolve gaps between workstreams so critical tasks do not fall between teams.

• Verify readiness firsthand. Walk the site, validate reported progress with functional owners, and confirm site, equipment, staffing, partner, and operational readiness against required gates. Confirm required checks and approvals are complete before launch; do not trade safety for schedule.

• Manage risks and resolve blockers. Identify risks early, assess their impact, and drive mitigations with the responsible teams. Resolve issues within your scope; escalate safety concerns immediately and larger tradeoffs early, with clear facts, options, and a recommendation.

• Report a clear picture from the field. Provide concise, accurate updates on what is ready, what has changed, what is blocked, the schedule impact, and which decisions or help are needed. Keep site plans, trackers, and launch records current.

• Complete a clear operational handoff. Stay engaged through early operations, confirm the receiving team has the information it needs, and ensure remaining actions have agreed owners and deadlines.

• Make the next launch better. Apply standard playbooks, readiness checklists, and reporting tools. Capture field learnings and recommend practical improvements that make launches safer, smoother, and more repeatable.

What You'll Bring

• Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in field operations, deployment, logistics, project coordination, or physical-site launches, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Experience owning a project, rollout, or operational workstream through completion in an environment with multiple teams and time-sensitive dependencies.

• Sound judgment and autonomy: you can prioritize, make decisions within your scope, and recognize when an issue needs escalation rather than improvisation.

• Ability to lead without formal authority, build trust with field teams and partners, and hold others accountable constructively.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including concise status updates that distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions and make the next action obvious.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the composure to adapt when plans change.

• Comfort working on-site and traveling frequently to U.S. launch locations. Approximately 50% travel is expected.

• Experience with physical infrastructure, construction, or real estate is helpful, but not required.

What Else You Need To Know

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

jobs.title: Strategic Delivery Lead, Cyber
jobs.description:
About the team

The OpenAI for Government team is a dynamic, mission-driven group leveraging frontier AI to transform how governments achieve their missions. Our team works to empower public servants with secure, compliant AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Gov) and mission-aligned deployments that meet government technical requirements with strong reliability and safety.

As part of the OpenAI for Government team you will work across the U.S. national security and cyber ecosystem, helping to accelerate adoption through hands-on support, tailored training, and early insights—so civil servants can spend less time on red tape and more on meaningful work. You will partner with government organizations to identify high-impact opportunities, translate complex cyber mission challenges into AI-enabled solutions, and drive secure deployments that help cyber professionals move faster and operate more effectively. If you're passionate about responsibly deploying frontier AI to uplift public institutions, strengthen cyber resilience, and transform how the government serves the American people, we want you on our team.

 

About the Role

The Strategic Delivery Lead (Cyber) will identify and deliver on some of OpenAI’s most complex and high-impact deployments for the U.S. national security and cyber enterprise. In this role, you will work closely with our national security partners and cyber mission owners to make their hardest problems solvable on the OpenAI Platform API and ChatGPT Enterprise.

The role is highly cross-functional and customer-facing: You’ll partner with Research, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, security teams, and external stakeholders to align on scope, unblock delivery, and communicate progress at every level, from technical teams to C-suite.

You will own and drive execution of technical delivery workstreams led by internal teams (Forward Deployed Engineers, Researchers, Solutions Architects), ensuring clear problem-framing, crisp milestone definitions, proactive risk identification, rapid issue resolution, and effective translation between business objectives and cyber mission requirements and technical solutions, while consistently communicating clear progress and demonstrating tangible value to national security customers. Accountability for contractual milestones and acceptance criteria sits with you.

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep program management expertise, executive presence, experience operating in cyber or national security environments, and a passion for making novel technology deliver real-world value.

 

In this role, you will:

 - Forge and manage strategic partnerships with key national security and cyber mission users to identify and deliver on the most impactful AI and AGI use cases.

 - Serve as the accountable lead for delivering high-impact national security and cyber-focused engagements tied to defined contractual milestones.

 - Act as a key translator between technical teams and business stakeholders, clearly articulating technical progress, risks, requirements, and dependencies in language accessible to both senior executives and technical practitioners.

 - Work with government, defense, industry partners, and academia to identify key concepts for national security AI use including cyber defense, threat intelligence, security operations, incident response, and vulnerability management workflows and then translate them into actionable delivery plans that align technical feasibility with national security impact.

 - Partner deeply with technical teams (FDEs, SAs, Research) to frame complex business and technical problems into actionable, scoped projects, serving as a strategic sounding board and thought leader to guide technical direction, anticipate blockers, and align teams proactively.

 - Establish best practices around milestone tracking, internal coordination, and delivery operations at scale.

 - Build internal consensus across teams with competing priorities, secure commitments from stakeholders you do not manage, and drive complex projects to completion with limited dedicated resources

 - Lead regular progress reviews with national security and cyber stakeholders, ensuring transparency and confidence in delivery.

 - Identify delivery risks early and work cross-functionally to mitigate blockers and maintain program velocity.

 - Navigate ambiguity and evolving requirements with composure, helping internal and external teams stay aligned.

 - Help shape the future of how OpenAI engages with national security and cyber customers through milestone-based delivery programs.

 

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, national security consulting, delivery leadership, or senior program management roles, driving complex technical initiatives across cross-functional teams to deliver results for national security missions.

 - Active U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance, with a strong preference for an active Counterintelligence or Full Scope Polygraph

 - Are willing to travel up to 50% and work on-site with national security and cyber customers to build strong relationships and deeply understand their needs.

 - Have experience leading organizational transformation initiatives (AI, digital, or business transformation) directly with national security departments or agencies.

 - Have led complex national security or cyber-focused programs in enterprise SaaS, AI/ML, consulting, cybersecurity, or transformation environments.

 - Have a proven track record influencing and shaping customer decision-making at executive/board level and the ability to drive clarity, accountability, and alignment at senior levels.

 - Demonstrated experience delivering outcomes in lean, fast-moving environments by influencing without authority, making thoughtful tradeoffs, and mobilizing cross-functional teams around the highest-priority work.

 - Strong track record of execution in delivering ambitious goals on complex cross-functional projects.

 - Prior experience managing large scale AI/ML or enterprise API-based deployments.

 - Are passionate about how AI and AGI can enhance the national security mission and strengthen cyber capabilities.

 - Thrive in extremely ambiguous, fast-moving environments and can create clarity and momentum where none yet exists.

 - See yourself as a bridge between frontier AI research and cyber mission impact, and are motivated by enabling that connection.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Identity
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



The Role

As our Senior Identity Engineer, you will own workforce and workload identity end-to-end — SSO, MFA, the joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle, privileged access, secrets, and service/machine identity — across corporate, cloud, and factory systems that handle export-controlled technical data. You will build an automation-first, least-privilege identity program that shrinks our largest attack surface while keeping engineers fast. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small, high-leverage security team in Los Angeles.

What You’ll Do

 - Design, implement, and operate our IdP stack (e.g., Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, Auth0, or Zitadel) — SSO, SCIM provisioning, and phishing-resistant MFA — and build the systems around it.

 - Build identity systems at scale that put OAuth 2.0 / OIDC / SAML and modern authorization models (RBAC and relationship-based access control) to work in production.

 - Own cloud identity end-to-end — Azure service principals, AWS IAM, and workload/service identity — and tie those identities cleanly to the underlying infrastructure.

 - Work cross-functionally to help other teams meet their identity needs, and automate the access lifecycle (joiner-mover-leaver) and reviews.

 - Partner with Detection & Response and Compliance/FSO so identity telemetry is detectable, actionable, and audit-ready.

What We’re Looking For

 - You can build. Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping identity systems at scale — not just configuring a vendor tool or leaning on AI-assisted coding.

 - Real command of core identity concepts — OAuth 2.0 flows, OIDC, SAML, RBAC, and relationship-based access control (ReBAC) — and the ability to design systems that exploit these protocols well.

 - Hands-on depth with one or more IdPs (Okta / Entra / Google Workspace / Auth0 / Zitadel), since day-to-day is implementing, designing, and integrating these platforms.

 - Cloud identity depth — Azure service principals, AWS IAM — and a clear grasp of how those identities map to real infrastructure.

 - The autonomy and urgency to own the identity domain end-to-end on a small, high-leverage team with minimal direction.

What Will Set You Apart

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Order and Billing Operations Analyst, you will be tasked with managing the end-to-end billing process, from processing sales orders and invoicing to resolving billing inquiries and supporting collections. You will collaborate closely with internal teams and external partners to ensure billing accuracy, support audit and reconciliation efforts, and contribute to system and process improvements as we scale. This position reports to the Billing Operations Manager at SentinelOne.

This is a hybrid position based out of the SentinelOne office in Heredia, Costa Rica.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Process sales orders into the billing system, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.

• Interface with channel partners to gather purchase orders and support credit consumption invoicing.

• Invoice customers with a focus on timeliness, completeness, and accuracy.

• Respond promptly and professionally to account, invoice, and billing inquiries from customers, channel partners, and internal Customer Success teams, and resolve invoice-related questions and disputes.

• Support collections operations, including reaching out to partners with past-due accounts, as needed.

• Participate in system and process optimization projects to help scale operations.

• Field audit requests as appropriate.

• Perform account reconciliations of bookings and billings.

• Interface with partners, management, and team members to review accounts and escalate issues as necessary.

• Calculate monthly MSSP (Managed Security Service Provider) consumption data for billing purposes.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• Bachelor's degree or Associate degree in Accounting is preferred.

• Experience with billing systems such as NetSuite and Salesforce, or similar software.

• Familiarity with subscription and overage usage billing practices in different geographies, including the US and globally.

• Working knowledge of, or willingness to learn, US sales tax billing requirements.

• Strong professional communication skills with the ability to clearly convey information to various stakeholders.

• Willingness to work Costa Rica time zone hours with some overlap to US West Coast hours for meetings.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to resolve open questions to conclusion as a strong individual contributor.

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks, set priorities, and meet tight deadlines to achieve collection targets.

• Proficiency in Excel, with working knowledge of formulas and pivot tables.

• Desire to leverage AI tools to automate routine tasks.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
