jobs.title: Director, IT
jobs.description:
DNSFilter's mission is to protect our customers and partners with products they love to use! We are revolutionizing network security by providing fast, accurate, and reliable threat protection and content filtering. We're a rapidly growing company dedicated to creating a safer internet for businesses and organizations worldwide. Leveraging AI-driven threat intelligence, DNSFilter empowers our customers to proactively block threats before they impact their networks. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and results-oriented culture where every team member contributes to our mission of making the internet safer.

We are a security company, and how we run our own systems should reflect that. Our internal IT function has kept pace with a growing company through automation rather than headcount, and it is ready for someone to own it end to end. That's where you come in!

We are looking for a Director of IT, based in our Tampa office, to own internal identity, endpoints, and employee technology at DNSFilter. This is a hands-on leadership role, not an oversight role. You will run Okta, Google Workspace, and our MDM platforms yourself while leading one Senior IT Support Analyst, and you will be accountable for whether our controls actually work, not just whether they are configured. The ideal candidate has built an IT function at this stage before, is comfortable in the consoles, and would rather automate a recurring problem than staff it.

This role reports to the SVP of Operations and partners closely with Security, People, Finance, and every department that depends on getting access to their tools on day one.

This is a full-time hybrid-office role for our Tampa (Westchase), Florida office.

Eligible candidates have worked successfully in a small- to mid-sized, fast-paced, hyper-growth SaaS start-up or scale-up.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you feel like this job is for you, please apply. We believe diversity of experience and skills, including transferable skills, combined with passion, is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions!

In this role, you will:

Identity and Access

• Own Okta day to day: user administration, SSO configuration, app assignments, MFA policy implementation, lifecycle rules, and Okta Desktop MFA across the fleet

• Own Google Workspace administration, including groups, distribution lists, delegated access, and directory hygiene

• Own the onboarding, offboarding, and change management lifecycle end to end, and be accountable for the number that says access was actually revoked on time

• Partner with Security to define, and own the operation of, the access model for contractors and BYOD users, including what they can reach, how it is isolated from personal use, and how access and company data end when an engagement does

• Reduce the volume of manual access requests through automation, group-based entitlements, and self-service, rather than by working the queue faster

Endpoint and Fleet

• Own Mosyle for Apple and JumpCloud for everything else: enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment, patch posture, and device inventory

• Ensure every company device is enrolled through a supervised path, and close the gaps where it is not

• Maintain accurate fleet coverage reporting, including whether our own machines run DNSFilter's Roaming Client under an enforcing policy

• Support the Security team's rollout of endpoint security tooling on the devices you manage

Asset Lifecycle

• Own hardware end to end: procurement through Insight and CDW, zero-touch enrollment and provisioning, asset tagging, drop-ship to employees, and return logistics

• Redeploy returned devices under three years old before ordering new, and route anything three years or older to certified recycling

• Maintain an accurate record of every deployed device that reconciles to headcount, MDM, and Finance's asset register

• Manage warranty, repair, and replacement, and own the refresh cycle and the budget behind it

• Own retirement: secure wipe, certified disposal, and the documentation that proves a device was sanitized before it left our hands

• Own device recovery from departing employees and contractors, including the follow-up on equipment that has not been returned

Application Portfolio and Spend

• Own the full inventory of business applications, including what sits outside SSO and how it got there

• Manage licenses against actual usage, reclaim what is unused, and bring renewals forward with a recommendation rather than an invoice

• Own the IT budget: build it, forecast it, and be able to explain why spend moved

• Own IT vendor relationships and contracts, and make the call when a tool is no longer earning its cost

Workplace Technology

• Own the technology in our Tampa office: the Ubiquiti stack end to end, including UniFi network and wifi, Access with facial recognition entry, and Protect cameras

• Own physical access and surveillance systems in partnership with People Ops and Security, including who has access to what, retention of footage, and handling of biometric data

• Own conference room AV, printers, and shared office equipment

• Make in-office and hybrid meetings work reliably, because the ones that do not are the ones everyone remembers

Service Delivery

• Own the Zendesk helpdesk: intake, taxonomy, priority definitions, SLAs, and customer satisfaction measurement

• Report a small set of IT metrics monthly, and be the person who explains the number when it moves the wrong way

• Publish a service catalog so the company knows what IT does, how to ask for it, and what to expect

Availability and Continuity

• Define and run the escalation path for IT incidents, including lockouts, outages, and issues that hit people while traveling

• Own IT business continuity: what we do when a core system is unavailable, and how we get people working again

• Set clear expectations with the company on response, escalation, and after-hours coverage, and hold the team to them

Automation and AI

• Extend our internal automation, which already covers onboarding, offboarding, directory sync, and ticket triage, and treat AI deflection as the way this team scales instead of headcount

• Build integrations and reporting across Okta, Google, Mosyle, JumpCloud, and Zendesk so our compliance evidence assembles itself

• Convert solved tickets into documented runbooks that feed the next automation

Security Partnership

• Implement the controls Security defines, and give Security the evidence they need to verify those controls are working

• Own the IT side of SOC 2 control operation and audit evidence, in partnership with our Security and Compliance team

• Run access reviews through our compliance platform: quarterly for high-risk applications, annually for the full application portfolio

• Escalate clearly and early when a configuration decision has security consequences

Growth and Integration

• Lead the IT side of acquisitions: integrating identity, devices, applications, and support for an incoming team

• Bring a plan for consolidating onto our stack, with a realistic sequence and an honest view of what breaks along the way

Leadership

• Lead, coach, and grow one Senior IT Support Analyst, and build the technical depth of that role

• Set the operating cadence: what gets reviewed weekly, what gets reported monthly, and what escalates immediately

To qualify for this role, you have:

• 7+ years in IT, including 2+ years leading an internal IT function or team

• Deep hands-on experience administering an enterprise identity provider, ideally Okta, including SSO, MFA policy, and lifecycle management

• Hands-on experience administering Apple MDM at fleet scale, ideally Mosyle or Jamf, plus experience managing non-Apple endpoints

• Experience owning Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration

• Experience owning hardware asset lifecycle, including inventory accuracy, remote provisioning and returns, and secure device retirement

• Experience owning an IT budget, vendor contracts, and software licensing

• Demonstrated experience building or materially improving an onboarding, offboarding, and change management lifecycle

• Experience operating IT controls under SOC 2 or a comparable framework, including producing audit evidence

• A track record of automating recurring work rather than absorbing it

• Ability to communicate clearly and directly with non-technical stakeholders, including executives, about what broke and what you are doing about it

• Located in the Tampa, FL area and able to work on site from our Tampa office

• Must be eligible to work in the region of hire without sponsorship now and/or in the future

Bonus points for:

• Experience at a security company, or in an environment where IT hygiene is a customer-facing question

• Scripting or automation experience, whether Python, Google Apps Script, or similar

• Experience building with AI tooling, including agents, MCP servers, or LLM-assisted ticket deflection

• Experience integrating an acquired company's identity, devices, and tooling

• Familiarity with Zendesk, BambooHR, Ramp, Vanta, or 1Password

• You are still comfortable in the console, and you have no interest in leading a team whose work you could not do yourself

• You find the systemic cause behind a recurring ticket rather than closing it faster each time

• You tell people what will happen before it happens, and what happened after it did

We Offer:

• Pathway to promotion based on results and performance, not just time in the chair. You help us grow, and we will help you grow.

• Passionate and intelligent colleagues who work hard and have a good time doing it

• Paid company-wide week off at the end of each year

• Flexible Vacation Policy

• Awesome company swag

• Full medical, dental, and vision benefits for US, UK, and Canada-based employees

• Full short-term disability and life benefits; available long-term disability

• Retirement savings account options with vested company matching for qualifying employees

• In-person annual gatherings. Last time we all spent a week on a beach in the Dominican Republic!

DNSFilter is a pay-for-performance organization, which means there is an opportunity to advance your compensation based on performance over time. The hiring base pay is dependent on several factors, including level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and geographic location. As a hybrid company, our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. and global geographic markets. We pay differently based on those defined markets. Our Talent Team can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

DNSFilter participates in the E-Verify program.

At DNSFilter, we utilize sophisticated software and tools to identify and eliminate Deepfake candidates. This approach helps us maintain the integrity of our hiring process, ensuring that we select the most qualified and genuine individuals to join our team.

U.S. hiring salary range

$140,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer -Water Technologies
jobs.description:
The Lead Electrical & Controls engineer will be responsible for supporting the execution of MWIS projects. Working with the Mechanical Engineering team, the Electrical & Controls engineer is responsible for the design of the control and automation strategy for the system. Control design responsibilities include developing the control narrative, control logic charts, PLC program, and drawings including electrical layout and panel drawings. Electrical design responsibilities include completing the electrical design and developing single line diagrams, field wire lists, I/O lists, network architecture, panel design and schematics. Electrical & Controls engineers provide support to production facilities and assist the Service team through installation and commissioning.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following.

• Contribute to preparation of Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID)
• Read and process engineering documents, including P&IDs, GAs, process design. guidelines, Electrical Schematics, I/O Lists, instrument and valve lists, Network Architecture, return of experience, and engineering best practices guides.
• Interpret, comment and follow contract and customer specifications.
• Design the complete detailed control logic for plant operation (Control Philosophy, Control Logic & Sequence Charts) with operator and equipment safety in mind.
• Support Electrical, Control & Instrumentation design of standard products.
• Support of commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting activities.
• Manage budget, scope and schedule and proactively report risks and opportunities to project teams.
• Develop control system architecture
• Prepare schematics, layouts and bills of material for control panel fabrication
• Develop control strategies including narratives and operational sequence charts
• Develop PLC and HMI programs, typically from a “basis” project

Education & Experience

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or other Engineering Technical degree. Candidates with relevant work experience where the candidate has demonstrated the ability to perform the required duties and responsibilities may also be considered.
• 5 years of experience in the design of industrial water treatment systems.
• Proficiency with Allen Bradley, GE Fanuc, Wonderware, Siemens and/ or other common platforms programmable controls and HMI’s.
• Familiarity with the NEC and UL508A
• Experience working with Process and Instrumentation Diagrams
• Familiar with industrial scale water treatment system design and execution including ultrafiltration, clarification, media filtration, reverse osmosis, ion exchange, and EDI.
• Demonstrated technical knowledge of control system design including motor controls
• Understanding of Low Voltage Power Distribution System design.
• Understanding of High/ Medium Voltage Power Distribution System design.
• Familiarity with Google Tools, MS Office, SAP and ability to learn other software applications
• Ability to work in an industrial and manufacturing environment.
• Ability to travel 25% of the time and live in proximity to a major airport.

Preferred:

● Communicative and social – Must be able to communicate well with teams

● Continual improvement – Must seize all opportunities to improve the department’s products and

processes. Continually be learning new tools and techniques to manage oneself and the team

● Conflict resolution – Must be able to facilitate discussion and facilitate alternatives or different

approaches

● Attitude of transparency – Must embrace transparency both up and down the organization in regards

to schedules, performance, NCR's, and other KPI's related to department performance.

● Mentor – Experience mentoring and training other team members.

Join a company that values Responsibility, Solidarity, Innovation, Customer Focus, and Respect. You'll have opportunities for comprehensive technical and commercial training, career advancement, and the chance to make a meaningful impact on sustainability and environmental protection.

This position includes incentive compensation eligibility and account assignment opportunities.

Ready to advance your career while making a difference in water treatment and sustainability? Apply today!

The work is field-heavy, travel-heavy, and performed in customer-facing data center environments, including active construction sites, white space, staging areas, loading docks, raised-floor areas, and operational facilities.

jobs.title: Experiential Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

In this role, you will work closely with marketing and business partners to plan and execute go-to-market programs for a portfolio of physical and live experiences. You will help bring a globally recognized entertainment brand to life through theme park attractions, location-based experiences, events, exhibitions, and other experiential programs. You will work with operators, venues, production companies, creative agencies, and cross-functional marketing partners to develop campaigns from strategy through execution, while managing timelines, budgets, assets, approvals, and performance reporting. The role is remote with flexibility to accommodate time-zone differences and will be measured by the successful execution of go-to-market campaigns

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and activate brand marketing programs for a portfolio of theme park lands and attractions, location-based experiences, traveling exhibitions, fan events, and experiential brand activations.

• Partner with experience operators, production companies, venue partners, and creative agencies to develop opening campaigns, ongoing marketing programs, and seasonal campaigns that drive awareness, attendance, and brand engagement.

• Own end-to-end brand marketing for experiences, from strategy and positioning through go-to-market planning and in-market execution.

• Translate franchise and business priorities into clear marketing briefs, messaging frameworks, creative direction, and integrated campaigns that resonate with audiences and guests.

• Build scalable frameworks, toolkits, and operating models that enable experiences marketing programs to scale across partners, venues, regions, and major franchise moments while maintaining brand consistency.

• Identify opportunities to extend the brand into culture and community through fan events, conventions, pop-ups, live moments, and other experiential programs that generate earned media and reinforce broader franchise engagement.

• Develop integrated communications plans across owned, earned, paid, partner, retail, and on-site channels, collaborating with editorial, social, web, PR, influencer, community, media, and regional marketing partners.

• Manage program operations including scopes, timelines, budgets, contracts, approvals, creative assets, on-site execution, invoicing, and reporting.

• Monitor program performance, including attendance, audience growth, brand impact, and earned reach, and use insights to support continuous improvement and test-and-learn initiatives.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of marketing experience in theme parks, location-based entertainment, experiential or event marketing, live entertainment, or destination marketing.

• Direct experience working at or alongside established experience operators, IP holders, theme park organizations, location-based entertainment companies, traveling exhibitions, large-scale live events, or experiential agencies.

• Proven experience managing partnerships with operators, venues, production companies, and agencies while balancing brand integrity with commercial objectives.

• Strong understanding of place-based and experiential marketing, including opening campaigns, ongoing attendance marketing, seasonal programs, and on-site guest experience marketing.

• Experience developing and executing integrated marketing programs across owned, earned, paid, partner, retail, and on-site channels.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs while balancing scope, timelines, budgets, venues, and external partners.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills within matrixed organizations and external partner environments.

• Strong business communication, writing, and relationship-building skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience marketing theme park lands, attractions, location-based entertainment, or large-scale live events for IP-led experience operators.

• Experience marketing global entertainment properties, gaming franchises, or other large consumer brands across both physical and digital touchpoints.

• Familiarity with player- and fan-driven communities and experience creating programs that build cultural relevance, audience engagement, and repeat visitation.

Salary Range

Pay ranges vary based on multiple factors including, without limitation, skill sets, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographical market. The pay range for this position reflects geographic based ranges for Washington state: $90,000- $100,000 USD annually. The salary/wage and job title for this opening will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience and may be outside this range.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Finance Automation
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to join the Finance AI & Automation team within the Office of the CFO. In this role, you will serve as a primary technical authority and builder, transforming working AI prototypes into enterprise-grade backend microservices, data pipelines, and internal tools that eliminate manual friction across the finance stack.

Sitting on a central Engineering team, you will bridge the gap between rapid AI innovation and robust systems architecture. While your primary mastery lies in distributed backend systems and event-driven integrations, you will also own the lightweight frontend UI surfaces and operator tools that allow Finance teams to interact with these automations seamlessly.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Hands-on Execution & Leadership: Spend the majority of your time "hands-on-keyboard," architecting, coding, and operating high-performance backend services using Kotlin and AWS.

• Productionize AI Workflows: Take working agentic prototypes built by Finance operators and turn them into scalable, monitored, and permissioned microservices with audit trails and automated error handling.

• End-to-End Internal Tooling: Build pragmatic, full-stack operator tools—from backend APIs and pipelines down to the lightweight UI surfaces used daily by collections analysts and revenue accountants to run and monitor automations safely.

• Integration & Systems Architecture: Design resilient integrations across billing platforms, ERP systems, Salesforce, data warehouses, and internal Toast services using enterprise integration patterns.

• Design for Enterprise Controls: Proactively engineer around SOX scope, PCI boundaries, and data access requirements alongside Security, Compliance, and Audit teams from day one.

• Technical Ownership & Strategic Handoffs: Own end-to-end technical strategy from high-level business problems down to build sequencing. Recognize when fixes belong in core Toast platforms, driving technical cases and clean handoffs rather than duplicating capabilities.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Backend-Focused with Pragmatic Full-Stack Reach: Proven track record as a Staff (or senior-level lead) engineer with deep expertise in distributed backend systems, paired with the practical ability to ship frontend UI surfaces or admin portals when an internal tool requires it.

• Production Kotlin & AWS: Advanced hands-on experience shipping Kotlin (or strong JVM equivalent) services on AWS, with deep familiarity in cloud-native backend patterns.

• Applied AI & Systems Fluency: Practical experience productionizing LLM frameworks and agentic architectures (tool use, retrieval/RAG, evals, context management) paired with strong judgment on when an AI agent is required versus a traditional backend system or cron job.

• Event-Driven & Integration Architecture: Extensive experience with enterprise integration frameworks, message brokers, and distributed data stores—specifically Apache Camel, Apache Pulsar, DynamoDB, and Dropwizard (or direct equivalents).

• Data Systems Depth: Advanced data engineering instincts across SQL, warehouse modeling, pipeline design, and managing data flow/consistency across relational and NoSQL storage systems.

• Pragmatic Technical Strategy & Communication: Ability to balance immediate high-impact automation with long-term platform scalability, accompanied by exceptional technical writing that translates complex architectural trade-offs to executive stakeholders.

What will help you stand out (Nonessentials/Nice to Haves)

• Extensive background in Fintech, revenue systems, automated reconciliation, or operating within strict SOX/PCI control environments.

• Deep experience building internal platforms, administrative dashboards, or operator tooling for non-technical business users.

• Prior experience embedded directly alongside finance, revenue, or business ops functions to solve core operational scaling challenges.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A

$193,000—$309,000 USD

Zone B

$168,000—$269,000 USD

Zone C

$151,000—$242,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

jobs.title: Analyst, Market Optimization & Trading
jobs.description:
What The Role Is

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Energy Management, the Analyst, Market Optimization & Trading, will support the development and execution of trading, hedging, and optimization strategies for Clearway’s ERCOT and PJM assets. The Analyst will work in close coordination with the Market Optimization & Trading, Market Fundamentals, Business Development, Origination, Asset Management, Credit and Energy Risk, and Operations groups to help manage Clearway’s market exposure while building deep expertise in nodal power market analytics within a rapidly growing organization.

If you do not meet 100% of the below qualifications but see yourself contributing, please submit your resume.

What You'll Be Doing

• Support the development and execution of day-ahead, real-time, and term trading and hedging strategies for Clearway’s ERCOT and PJM assets, including energy, ancillary services, and basis positions.

• Assist in identifying and analyzing congestion market risk, including congestion.

• Support participation in CRR/FTR auctions and virtual bidding strategies.

• Work with Credit and Energy Risk to support the internal approval process for trading counterparties and transactions.

• Communicate with project stakeholders on market conditions, trading risks, and optimization opportunities.

• Work with the Market Analytics and Credit and Energy Risk teams to develop and enhance tools for position management, reporting, trade capture, and the eventual implementation of an enterprise risk management system.

• Develop, operate, and maintain production cost and price forecasting models (e.g., using tools such as UPLAN, PROMOD, or Dayzer) to support nodal price and congestion forecasting for ERCOT and PJM.

• Leverage data to create tools and automate workflows.

• Mark and maintain forward price curves for ERCOT and PJM power products, and support stochastic risk modeling and correlation assumptions.

• Prepare recurring and ad-hoc market recaps, outlooks, and presentation materials summarizing ERCOT and PJM fundamentals, price drivers, and trading performance for internal stakeholders.

• Support day-to-day position management and P&L reporting for ERCOT and PJM trading portfolios.

• Oversee the Energy Management documentation process, leveraging Clearway’s internal and external subject matter experts to bring trading, ISO, QSE, and enabling agreements to execution.

• Participate in energy working groups, professional organizations, trade shows & conferences.

• Track and report on ERCOT and PJM policy and regulatory developments, including ISO market rule changes, that may impact trading strategy, leveraging Clearway’s internal and external subject matter experts.

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

• Maintain confidentiality and sensitivity with respect to all functions of CEG.

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, business administration, engineering, economics, mathematics, meteorology, or a related quantitative field.

• 0-2 years of relevant experience

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a curious, inquisitive mindset and a genuine drive to understand how power markets work. Prior trading experience is not required – relevant coursework, internship, or academic research in a quantitative field will also be considered.

• Interest in or exposure to ERCOT and/or PJM market structure, including day-ahead and real-time markets, CRR/FTRs, and ancillary services, is a plus but not required.

• Solid understanding of power markets, including forwards, futures, swaps, and options.

• Ability to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets relevant to energy markets to support trading and risk decisions.

• Proficiency with Python, SQL, or other coding/statistical tools is a plus.

• Highly motivated, self-starter, friendly personality, and good team player.

• Attention to detail and inclination towards structure, organization, and process – as well as the ability to examine, question, and improve on the inputs and recommendations of others.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to oversee multiple projects simultaneously, track progress and needs of each, and provide high-quality deliverables accurately and on time.

• Able to work well with geographically dispersed, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel; proficient in Word and PowerPoint.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Sourcer
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Our EPD Recruiting team builds the teams that build Plaid. We partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, and Security to deliver thoughtful, candidate-first recruiting experiences that raise the bar for how we scale.

We are responsible for delivering world-class technical talent through pragmatic, data-informed, and principle-aligned recruiting practices. We believe the hardest hires are won upstream, in the research and the reach-out, long before a loop is ever scheduled.

Our goal is to help Plaid grow intentionally by hiring exceptional people who share our values and drive our mission to unlock financial freedom for everyone.

We are hiring a Senior Technical Sourcer to build the pipelines behind Plaid's most difficult technical searches. You will own the top of the funnel across software engineering, infrastructure, data science, AI/ML, and security, from market research and pipeline strategy to qualified candidates entering the interview process.

This role is for a deep researcher. Many of the people we need are not always findable by title alone, do not respond to templated outreach, and are not on any list you can buy. You will find them anyway, by mapping the market, reading the work, and writing outreach that earns a reply from someone who ignores twenty recruiter messages a week.

You will carry a high req load across multiple technical domains at once, and you will do it without losing the details that make a pipeline trustworthy. You will also turn what you learn into intelligence the team can use: where the talent actually sits, what competitors are building and paying for, and what a role needs to look like to be winnable.

This is a high-visibility seat. The quality of what enters our funnel shapes every hiring decision downstream.



Responsibilities:

 - Own top-of-funnel strategy and execution for technical reqs across engineering, infrastructure, data, AI/ML, and security. You build the pipeline, engage and qualify the candidate, and hand off a qualified, well-briefed person to the recruiter.

 - Run deep talent research. Market maps, org mapping, competitor teardowns, conference and publication mining, open-source and technical community research, and advanced boolean and x-ray search across sources most people do not think to check.

 - Find niche and emerging technical talent where the qualified pool is small and almost entirely passive, including AI/ML, applied research, distributed systems, and security engineering.

 - Write outreach that gets answered. You personalize based on what someone has actually built, you test your messaging, and you own your response rate as a number you can explain.

 - Operate at volume without losing precision. You run multiple searches at once with disciplined follow-up cadences, accurate ATS hygiene, and clean data that others can trust.

 - Turn research into intelligence. Build market maps, talent density views, and competitive hiring insights, then bring them to recruiters and hiring managers to shape role scope, leveling, and search strategy.

 - Build diverse pipelines by design, through the breadth of your research and the inclusivity of your outreach, not as a screening step at the end.

 - Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers on calibration. You bring the market back into the room when a role as written is not findable, and you propose what would make it winnable.

 - Track and report your funnel. Response rate, screen pass rate, and stage conversion tell you where to spend your next hour. Use them, and share what they say.

 - Represent Plaid authentically. You are often a candidate's first impression of us, and that first conversation sets the tone for everything after it.



Qualifications:

 - 6+ years of technical sourcing/recruiting experience, including in-house sourcing at a high-growth technology company.

 - Mastery of sourcing research technique and tooling: boolean and x-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub and technical communities, publications and conference sources, and CRM or ATS sourcing workflows. You can find people who are not searchable by just title or company name.

 - Demonstrated success in high-volume, high-urgency environments, carrying multiple technical searches at once without dropping the details.

 - Genuine fluency in technical skill sets. You can read a job spec, a GitHub profile, or a research paper and make a defensible call on relevance.

 - Proven track record sourcing for at least one hard-to-fill domain such as AI/ML, data science, data infrastructure, distributed systems, or security engineering. (Bonus if you’ve done it in a fintech space.)

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Your outreach is short, specific, and human, and senior engineers reply to it.

 - Data discipline. You use funnel metrics to decide where to spend effort, and you can explain your pipeline with numbers rather than anecdotes.

 - Meticulous attention to detail and personal ownership of your data hygiene. If your pipeline data is wrong, no one downstream can plan.

 - A candidate-first approach built on empathy, transparency, and consistent follow-through.

Nice-to-Have

 - Experience sourcing in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environments.

 - Experience producing talent intelligence or market mapping work that was presented to senior leadership and changed a hiring decision.

 - Experience building sourcing playbooks, training other sourcers, or evaluating and rolling out sourcing tooling or process efficiency projects.

 - Experience sourcing for distributed or international teams.

 - Familiarity with inclusive sourcing practices and a track record of building diverse technical pipelines.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!



Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.



Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here https://plaid.com/legal/#candidate-privacy-notice.


Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

jobs.description:
About BizzyCar

BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. We value our employees’ time and efforts. Our commitment to your success is enhanced by our competitive compensation and benefits package including paid time off, medical, dental, 401k, vision and equity benefits and future growth opportunities within the company. We strive to provide a collaborative, creative environment where each person feels encouraged to contribute to our processes, decisions, planning and culture. Why Authentic

Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.

What You’ll Do

• Work directly with athletes to capture authentic, high impact content

Cottonwood Residential is a forward-thinking, fully integrated real estate company focused on the multifamily sector. The Property Manager is responsible for the overall performance, operations, and financial success of a multifamily community. This role leads all on-site functions, including leasing, resident experience, financial management, and property maintenance, while ensuring alignment with Cottonwood Residential’s standards and objectives. The Property Manager drives a culture of service excellence, accountability, and collaboration. This role is ideal for a results-driven professional who can balance financial performance, team leadership, and resident satisfaction to maximize asset value and deliver strong operational outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Financial & Asset Management

• Manage the financial performance of the community, including operating within budget and achieving revenue and expense targets

• Oversee rent collection, delinquency management, and bad debt recovery, including participation in legal proceedings as necessary

• Review and approve invoices to ensure accuracy, proper coding, and budget alignment

• Assist the Regional Manager in developing and managing the annual operating budget

• Analyze financial reports, occupancy trends, and market data to drive informed decision-making

Operations & Property Oversight

• Oversee the daily operations of the community, ensuring efficiency, organization, and compliance with company policies

• Conduct regular property inspections to identify maintenance needs, safety concerns, and opportunities for improvement

• Oversee Self-Guided Tour operations, including unit readiness, signage, and daily inspections

• Maintain accurate and complete records, including resident files, vendor contracts, property inventory, and compliance documentation

• Ensure all administrative systems and property management data are accurate and up to date

Leasing, Marketing & Resident Experience

• Develop and execute marketing and leasing strategies to achieve occupancy and revenue goals

• Conduct regular market surveys and competitive analysis to inform pricing and positioning

• Oversee leasing performance, ensuring effective use of sales techniques and marketing tools

• Implement resident retention programs to drive renewals and satisfaction

• Ensure a high level of responsiveness to resident requests and service needs

• Plan and support resident engagement initiatives and community events

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, coach, and develop all on-site office and maintenance team members

• Provide ongoing feedback, coaching, and development opportunities to support team success

• Set clear expectations and monitor performance against property and company goals

Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations

• Promote safety awareness and ensure adherence to OSHA standards across the community

• Identify and address potential risks, safety hazards, and operational concerns proactively

• Maintain appropriate documentation for permits, licenses, and regulatory requirements

What You Bring

• High school diploma or GED required; college degree preferred

• Professional designations such as CAM, ARM, or CCRM preferred

• 3+ years of experience in multifamily property management

• 3+ years of experience leading, developing, and managing on-site teams

• Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, reporting, and expense management

• Solid understanding of leasing, marketing strategies, and resident retention

• Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills

• Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Effective problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite

• Experience with Entrata, REBA, or similar systems

• Self-starter with strong initiative, accountability, and a results-driven mindset

• Flexibility to work extended hours, including time prior to office opening

• Ability to walk the property, stand for extended periods, and work both indoors and outdoors as needed

Physical Requirements

• Stand or walk or sit alternatively depending on the day’s needs. Estimate 70% of time is spent on feet and 30% sitting at a desk.

• Bending, stooping, and squatting for filing and picking up litter around the property frequently

• Ability to climb stairs frequently needed to show and inspect the property.

• Pushing and pulling doors/cabinets to inspect the property frequently

• Reaching above the shoulders for supplies and inspecting the property frequently

• Writing/typing for communication frequently

• Grasping/turning for telephone and doorknob use frequently

• Finger dexterity to operate office equipment frequently

• Lifting/carrying 10-25 lbs. occasionally needed.

• Constant need for vision in small detail and beyond arm’s reach to view computer screens, reports, forms, inspecting property, etc.

• Constant need for hearing to communicate with staff, vendors, residents, and prospects in person and on the telephone.

We don’t just manage properties — we elevate them. At Cottonwood Residential, you’ll join a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. You’ll work alongside a team that is passionate about delivering exceptional living experiences while supporting your professional growth. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package and opportunities to grow within a dynamic, expanding organization.

jobs.description:
BAYADA Home Health Care is currently seeking an experienced Physical Therapist, PT, for an opportunity performing hospice visits for our office, located in Pennsauken, NJ. This office services adult and geriatric clients on a per visit basis in territories throughout Burlington and Camden counties.

Rate: 75/hour

One year prior clinical experience as a licensed Physical Therapist is required.  As a home care Physical Therapist, you will be an integral member of a multi-disciplinary health care team that provides rehabilitative care and skilled nursing to clients, affording them the opportunity to receive the medical care required to remain at home.

At BAYADA, we believe our employees are our greatest asset.  We are committed to investing in people and nurturing their desire to grow. Watch this video to learn more about field employee career pathing:

Responsibilities for a PT - Physical Therapist include:

• Make home visits to clients in designated geographic territories.

• Perform diagnostic tests and measurements, such as the mobility/range of joints, transfer status, stability, patterns and appearance of ambulation, strength and endurance of muscles, balance testing, and safety assessments.

• Develop and implement appropriate individualized care plans, including manual therapeutic exercises, gait training, balance, and other interventions.

• Continually assess and revise the Physical Therapy - PT care plan, and participate with nursing in the multidisciplinary care plan, as appropriate.

• Educate and instruct clients, family members, or other client representatives, in rehabilitative care and activities necessary to promote the client's health, safety, and independent living.

• Accurately document observations, interventions, and evaluations pertaining to client care management and services provided, utilizing a state-of-the-art touch pad tablet.

Qualifications for a PT - Physical Therapist include:

• A current NJ Physical Therapist - PT license.

• A minimum of one year of recent work experience as a Physical Therapist - PT.

• Graduation from a program approved by the American Physical Therapy Association or the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation of the American Medical Association, as indicated by school transcript or diploma.

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

jobs.title: Characterization Scientist
jobs.description:
The incumbent will participate in the formulation and process development of biotherapeutics. This position will be responsible for performing analytical testing and characterization of candidate molecules by using various biophysical, biochemical and particulates characterization techniques as well as supporting laboratory operations and maintenance. This is a laboratory-based position performing formulation and process development activities specifically for biotherapeutic products from pre-clinical and Ph I clinical trials through late stage, license application and commercialization. Furthermore, this position will assist in data compilation, data presentations, report authoring, and department documentation support.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

• Support the development of parenteral formulations for biotherapeutic modalities such as monoclonal antibodies, antibody drug conjugates, proteins, mRNA and vaccines.
• Perform rapid, comprehensive characterization of candidate molecules to determine the stability profile. This will be achieved by applying various biophysical, biochemical, particulates characterization techniques such as HPLC (SE-HPLC, IEX, HIC, RP-HPLC), Capillary Gel electrophoresis (CGE), imaged Capillary Electrophoresis (iCE), Spectroscopy techniques, light obscuration, microflow imaging and additional characterization techniques.
• Provide general laboratory support, including ordering/replacement of reagents and consumables, general maintenance of equipment, continuous improvement activities, and participating in periodic lab inspections.
• The incumbent must be able to interact effectively with a multidisciplinary team of scientists for formulation optimization and overall candidate progression.
• This position will be responsible for preparing data summary presentations, providing data verification support, compiling data, and using lab-based systems for data collection such as Empower and electronic laboratory notebooks.
• Effective communication skills are required for interactions with laboratory scientists, project managers and colleagues from numerous functions.

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

• At least a BS in Pharmaceutics, Chemistry, Chemical/Biochemical Engineering, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, Biology or equivalent
• 1+ years of industry experience utilizing some sort of chromatography (preferrably HPLC)
• Familiarity with biologics such as proteins, enzymes, monoclonal antibodies, vaccines, mRNA, or antibody drug conjugates and how to characterize them with analytical techniques
• Must be eligible to work in the United States indefinietly without restriction or sponsorship (OPT, H1B, etc.)

Preferred:

• Familiarity with HPLC, Capillary electrophoresis, and other analytical techniques
• Strong computer skills and experience with lab-based computer systems
• Ability to collect and analyze data sets

Positions are full-time, working Monday-Friday 8am-5pm, overtime as needed.  Candidates currently living within commutable distance to Andover, MA are encouraged to apply.

Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options

• Life and disability insurance

This role is responsible for architecting, operating, validating, and optimizing data migration pipelines that move high volume, multi-source datasets from legacy environments into modern cloud platforms. jobs.description:
ON.energy is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers.

Location: This position will be primarily located in the Greater Denver, CO area, with travel expected to Houston, Texas five to six times per year.

The Principal Test Engineer will serve as a master in electrical engineering, establishing technical direction, standards, and best practices. This individual will be the facilitator of product development, validation, and de-risking activities. They will be responsible for the end-to-end planning and execution of advanced validation cycles within On’s own and partner facilities. The primary goals are to de-risk On Energy’s current and future product line system architecture through rigorous lab-based stress testing and to bridge the gap between lab results and reality by maintaining and operating lab capabilities to support training, troubleshooting, and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Test Orchestration and Planning

• Facility Coordination: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for principal investigators and facility managers.

• Test Protocol Development: Design and document detailed test procedures that utilize laboratory Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) research assets to validate On Energy’s performance under extreme conditions (e.g., rapid frequency response, grid and load transitions, or grid instability). Synthesize product design criteria, industry standards, and customer requests into detailed workplans.

• Compliance & Safety: Ensure all On Energy hardware and test procedures comply with industry safety standards and local Site Operations protocols.

De-risking & Technical Validation

• Failure Mode Discovery: Use laboratory controlled environment to identify edge-case failures that are impossible to test in live field environments.

• Data Translation: Analyze high-fidelity data streams from laboratory sensors to provide actionable feedback to the On Energy product and project teams, as well as to On Energy component vendors, for firmware/hardware iterations.

• Verification: Report on data collected relative to product requirements and performance criteria for internal and customer review.

On Energy Commissioning and Training Coordination

• Staff Mentorship: Use the testing phase at NLR as a live training ground for On Energy’s field commissioning staff, familiarizing them with system behavior, diagnostics, and recovery.

• Manual Development: Convert lab-based learnings into field-ready Commissioning SOPs and Troubleshooting Guides.

• Staff Rotation Management: Coordinate the rotation of On Energy field technicians through the NLR facility to ensure knowledge transfer is uniform across the commissioning department.

Experience & Requirements

• 12+ years of electrical engineering experience, recognized as a domain authority of product development, test validation and de-risking activities in the scope of power systems and grid-tied technologies

• Education: B.S./M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

• Familiarity: Prior experience testing and modeling grid code compliance of large inverter-based resources. Experience working at a National Lab or within the DOE framework is preferred.

• Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Power Electronics (Inverters/Rectifiers), and Grid-Forming technologies.

• The "Liaison" Factor: Exceptional communication skills—the ability to speak "Research" to NLR scientists and "Deployment" to On Energy field technicians.

Work Environment

jobs.title: MRI Technologist, Sacramento
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



We're looking for a Mobile MRI Technologist at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN

As a Mobile MRI Technologist, you are the clinical heartbeat of our physical operations. Reporting to the Director of Imaging Performance, you will lead the day-to-day clinical functions of our high-end mobile units. Unlike traditional "traveling" roles, our units are permanently parked, providing a stable home base for you to deliver exceptional care. You will be responsible for the end-to-end patient experience, from safety screening to high-fidelity imaging, while ensuring our facilities meet the gold standard of ACR compliance.

 

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

 

 - Clinical Precision: Executing high-quality MRI scans with a focus on diagnostic excellence and patient comfort.

 - Patient Care: Provide compassionate, patient-centered care by explaining MRI procedures, addressing concerns, and ensuring patient comfort and safety throughout imaging exams.

 - System Management: Taking full "ownership" of our Siemens Espree systems, ensuring the system performs at peak levels.

 - Quality Assurance: Managing documentation of daily QC/QA procedures required for safety and accreditation.

 - Patient Advocacy: Leading patient screening and safety protocols to ensure a seamless, anxiety-free experience for every visitor.

 - Technical Troubleshooting: Acting as the first line of defense for the unit by identifying equipment issues and collaborating with Field Service Engineers.

 - Workflow Optimization: Utilizing Acuity Scheduling and Google Workspace to manage patient flow and maintain digital records.

 


THE TOP 5 THINGS WE WANT YOU TO ACHIEVE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR ARE

 1. Clinical Autonomy: Establish yourself as the trusted lead for your site, managing full-day scan schedules with zero-to-minimal oversight.

 2. ACR Gold Standard: Successfully lead or maintain the ACR certification process for your mobile unit, ensuring 100% compliance with safety standards.

 3. Operational Fluidity: Master Acuity and Google Workspace to ensure all patient documentation is 100% accurate and submitted in real time.

 4. Zero Downtime Mentality: Develop a proactive maintenance relationship with Field Service Engineers, identifying and flagging potential system issues before they impact the patient schedule.

 5. Patient Satisfaction: Maintain a high patient NPS (Net Promoter Score) by delivering a "concierge-style" imaging experience that aligns with the Scan.com http://Scan.com mission.

 


WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

These might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - Accreditation: You hold a current ARRT (MR) credential.

 - Technical Expertise: You have extensive experience specifically navigating and scanning on Siemens Espree MRI systems.

 - Compliance Knowledge: You have a proven track record of obtaining or maintaining ACR certification for MRI facilities.

 - Safety First: You have a deep understanding of MRI safety protocols and rigorous screening procedures.

 - Problem-Solving Skills: You are comfortable troubleshooting technical issues and communicating effectively with engineers and stakeholders.

 - Digital Literacy: You are proficient with Google Workspace (Docs/Sheets) and are a quick study when it comes to scheduling software like Acuity.

 - Location Specifics: You are comfortable working in Sacramento, CA.

 


AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.

 - Tier 3 — For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-Aware. You lead with subject matter expertise, but you're comfortable using AI for things like admin, documentation, or research, so you can spend more time with patients—and you know where AI stops, and human judgment has to take over. (clinical, hands-on, and highly regulated roles where hands-on expertise is the core value)
   
   - Assessment: A practical exercise where you use AI tools live or in a take-home.

 


OUR VALUES

Always Play Offense

If we're not growing, we're dying. Everyone needs a bias for action. Speed and momentum, combined with quality execution, propel our business forward.

 - You don't quit on hard problems. Fail fast, dust off, go again.

 - You celebrate wins, then seek the next opportunity.

 - You see it, you fix it. No task is beneath you, at any level.

Build with the Best

The company we build is the team we build. If we don't have the right people in the right seats, doing the right things, we will fail.

 - Talent recognizes talent. You actively bring quality hires into the business.

 - You trust your colleagues to deliver.

 - You open-source your knowledge. You're never a single point of failure.

Care Deeply, Challenge Directly

Care enough to have the hard conversations, and don't dwell on them. Don't go up the chain to communicate. Go straight to the person.

 - Strong opinions, weakly held. You welcome challenge and feedback.

 - You get to the point: direct challenge plus an alternative solution.

 - You ask "why". Before calling something bad, understand why it exists.

Embrace Growth, Be Curious

Push the limits of your understanding and potential and you will be supported to get better.

 - You proactively seek feedback, whatever your level.

 - You invest in understanding our business: teams, customers, processes.

 - You invest in your own growth and are willing to unlearn.

We're a high-performing team with low ego. We hire people who are brilliant and kind, who give it straight, back it up with evidence, and change their mind when the facts change. We'll give you real ownership early, the tools to do the best work of your career, and colleagues who raise your game. In return, we ask for high standards, genuine care for patients and each other, and the drive to leave things better than you found them. If that sounds like you, let’s talk!



 


HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU

We keep our interview process short and sweet, and we're a nimble team that can progress at pace. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order of each step depending on team availability:

 1. Introductory call/interview with our Senior Talent Partner. The call is via telephone and will last around 30 minutes.

 2. Should it feel like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a video call with the hiring manager for around 45 minutes. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

 3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com http://Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to your role (see AI Requirements above).

 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, length varies depending on how many people and whether in person or via video call.

 5. Offer!

 


WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

 - Salary range of $115,000 - $145,000

 - Flexible remote or hybrid work options

 - Dedicated personal development budget

 - Medical, vision, and dental coverage

 - 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401k retirement plan

 - All the equipment you need to do your best work

 - Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team




DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!
