jobs.title: Staff Application and AI Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer to join Savvy Wealth at our NYC headquarters as our first dedicated security hire. This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds engineering role. You will execute the security strategy set by our Director of IT & Information Security and our CTO, with day-to-day work centered on identifying vulnerabilities, remediating them, and closing the longer-term gaps that make us exposed, both in our product and in the SaaS tools our teams use every day.

Savvy is an AI-forward company. Most of our engineering is AI-assisted, and we enable people across the business, including non-technical roles, to build with AI coding tools. That enablement is a core part of how we work, and we intend to keep it. Your job is to make it safe: setting security hygiene standards in our codebases, building guardrails around AI-assisted development, and partnering closely with our internal AI team so that speed and security move together. You will make the secure path the easy path.

This role is deliberately not a compliance or GRC position. There are no audits to run, no certifications to chase, and no questionnaires to fill out. This is purely technical security work: finding and eliminating the vectors that make us vulnerable.



Responsibilities:

 - Own vulnerability management end to end: identify, triage, prioritize by real-world risk, and drive remediation to closure across our product, codebases, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Cloudflare)

 - Build and operate our AppSec tooling pipeline: secrets scanning in CI and at the git layer, SCA/dependency scanning with triage SLAs, and SAST rollout on our most sensitive repos, tuned for signal over noise

 - Set and enforce security hygiene standards within our codebases, including code review standards that explicitly account for AI-generated code (authorship transparency, mandatory human review on security-sensitive paths)

 - Partner with our internal AI team to design guardrails that keep AI-assisted development, including vibe coding by non-technical builders, safe by default: sanctioned tooling, data handling boundaries, dependency vetting, and secure defaults for AI-built integrations

 - Secure the SaaS stack: harden configurations, review OAuth grants and third-party integrations, reduce misconfiguration risk across platforms like Google Workspace, GitHub, Rippling, and Slack

 - Help establish conditional access and identity-layer controls in partnership with IT (SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, managed-device posture)

 - Define cloud and SaaS configuration baselines for the infrastructure footprint we operate

 - Contribute to detection and response readiness: high-signal detections (new OAuth grants, mass code-host downloads, credential anomalies) and participate in incident response when needed

 - Work cross-functionally with Engineering, IT, and the internal AI team; clearly articulate risk, remediation paths, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
   



Must have:

 - 5+ years of hands-on security engineering experience, with significant time in application security or product security

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals; comfortable reading, writing, and remediating code, not just filing findings

 - Track record of enforcing security across technical and non-technical teams without slowing anyone down. The goal isn't to restrict how people work, it's to keep us safe while they keep working the way they need to.

 - Experience embedding security into existing workflows rather than bolting it on

 - Deep experience with the modern AppSec toolchain: secrets scanning, SCA/dependency scanning, SAST, and CI/CD security integration (GitHub-centric)

 - Practical experience securing SaaS environments: OAuth and third-party app review, configuration hardening, and least-privilege access design

 - Working knowledge of cloud security across AWS and/or GCP, and edge/CDN security (Cloudflare)

 - A pragmatic, risk-based mindset: you prioritize by what actually gets exploited, ship iteratively, and avoid drowning teams in noise

 - Strong perspective on AI-assisted development security: you understand how AI coding tools change the shape of AppSec risk (hallucinated dependencies, leaked secrets, insecure patterns at scale) and how to build guardrails without killing velocity

 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

 - Strong writing skills; Savvy is a written culture



Nice to have:

 - Experience building security programs at an early-to-mid stage company, taking a function from reactive to systematic

 - Experience with SaaS security posture management, CSPM, or identity threat detection

 - Familiarity with securing LLM-based tooling, agentic workflows, or internal AI platforms

 - Detection engineering experience (SIEM/MDR, high-signal alerting)

 - Fintech or financial services environment experience

 - Offensive security background (pentesting, bug bounty, red team) that informs how you defend


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans

 - NYC office in the heart of Manhattan

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

jobs.title: Deliverability Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT CORDIAL

We founded Cordial in 2014 on the belief that there should be more humanity and empathy in marketing—both in how brands communicate with their customers and in how technology companies work with brands. We built our company and platform purposefully, driven by a desire to inspire more thoughtful communication and to create experiences that feel more personal and human—for consumers, for the people at the companies we work with, and for Cordial employees. Today, brands like PacSun, Revolve, Abercrombie & Fitch, Realtor.com, L.L. Bean and Forbes rely on Cordial to drive revenue growth by sending a better message.

We chose the name Cordial to symbolize how we empower our clients to communicate with their customers, as well as how we do business: with transparency, collaboration, and trust. We're building a passionate team of individuals willing to learn, grow, and be thoughtfully challenged on a daily basis to continuously improve our product, company, and culture every single day.

OUR VALUES

• Communicate better than the rest

• Own it, every time

• Solve client problems tenaciously

• Make Waves

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Deliverability Consultant, you are considered a subject matter expert internally and externally. Your main focus will be helping guide our clients to sending success by interpreting deliverability-related data (bounce logs, engagement recency, SNDS, GPT, etc) on behalf of the client and providing meaningful, prescriptive, actionable guidance by way of reports, business reviews, and regular client meetings. You will occasionally help in the sales process and will be heavily involved in the implementation and onboarding of new clients. As a growth-stage startup, there are always extra tasks and projects to take on, so tackling side projects to help improve our processes and the client experience will be a big part of your day-to-day as well.

YOU WILL

• Be an advocate for our clients.

• Seamlessly adopt the Cordial deliverability philosophy (we are here to serve clients and interpret data on their behalf, therefore better equipping marketers for success via the Cordial platform).

• Onboard and implement the programs of a wide range of clients (with regard to volume, cadence, and industry).

• Work closely with Client Success Managers, Solutions Experts, and Support to best assist clients' needs and meet company goals.

• Manage internal stakeholders and external client expectations on projects and timelines.

• Collaborate with our Client Success, Strategy and Support teams to ensure we are continuously meeting and exceeding our clients' expectations and goals.

• Develop and share best practices with clients and internal teams.

• Document and record all ongoing project work.

• Produce content for our blog and knowledge base.

• Identify gaps in our processes and offer/implement creative solutions.

• Remain connected to email communities and report on industry trends and changes that will impact Cordial clients.

• Represent Cordial at industry functions and communities such as M3AAWG, EEC, EmailGeeks, CSA, etc.

ABOUT YOU

• 3+ years of experience in a deliverability-related role.

• Familiarity with MTA service providers (Sparkpost, SendGrid, PMTA, etc).

• Expertise in the intricacies of sending to top-level ISPs and MBPs (Microsoft, Gmail, VMG).

• Experience troubleshooting sending to APAC and EMEA regions a plus.

• Strong understanding of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, BIMI, etc), SMTP protocol, and industry best practices.

• Direct experience onboarding new clients (including IP and domain warmups).

• Autonomous in day-to-day work, with the ability to identify the next prioritised task.

• Ability to interpret high-level data on behalf of non-technical marketers and communicate the idea back in an easily digestible format.

• Experience consulting with C-level executives and other decision-makers.

• High emotional intelligence and strong communication skills necessary to assist in communicating with a wide range of individuals, internally and externally.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem resolution skills (diagnosis, option assessment, recommendation and escalation).

• Proficient in G Suite tools (Google Drive, Sheets, Docs, and Slides).

• Foundational understanding of APIs and other development tools (such as SQL) and BI tools (such as Tableau, Google Data Studio, etc) a strong plus.

• Able to manage multiple open projects at any point in time, with varying degrees of complexity and business priority.

• Adept at identifying issues, recognising patterns, proposing solutions and helping to create repeatable processes or documentation to assist with the long-term success of both our internal team, clients, and partners.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$100,000.00 - $120,000.00 annually. The compensation range may be adjusted based on experience and location. In combination with base salary, Cordial's compensation package includes equity and bonus, a robust benefit plan (medical/dental/vision/life), 401k match, flexible time off. Additionally, we offer perks such as monthly wellness and cell phone stipends, childcare and continued education yearly reimbursements. We pride ourselves in maintaining a healthy work/life balance, a strong dedication to DE&I efforts, and an overall respectful and open culture!

Cordial is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability status, sex (including pregnancy), age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Cordial is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to your recruiter once you've begun the interview process. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

jobs.title: Domino's General Manager (05752)
jobs.description:
You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically operating partners. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need skills – sound judgment, business acumen, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's at the forefront of the Quick Service Restaurant industry, with a benefits package to match! As an Operating Partner you will have the opportunity to run a $1-2 million business, with the safety net of a 43-store franchise. This is work experience you're going to use for a long time to come, ideally growing within the operation to ultimately guide and develop future Operating Partners, or perhaps franchise on your own. If that's not for you, consider this an ideal opportunity to learn the ins and outs of the Quick Service Restaurant industry, navigating labor costs, food costs, waste management, people management, and mastering the service industry. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team members are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities: Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun, and make more dough! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
• Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Benefits:

• Opportunity to hone leadership and managerial skills for future business use
• Learn the ins and outs of the Quick Service Restaurant industry - including managing food cost, labor cost, wage considerations, interviewing, people management, and the opportunity to manage a $1 million business
• Competitive salary structure (base + monthly bonus)
• Flexible & convenient schedule
• Advanced leadership development opportunities
• Health, Dental & Vision benefits
• Team Fox company engagement outings including company parties, and team development activities.
• Community involvement and local networking opportunities
• Professional development & travel incentives
• Opportunity to compete for national and global Domino's rewards

Physical Requirements: Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

Additional Requirements:

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check
• Must pass Motor Vehicle Record Check, meeting company-specific standards

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Lead Logistics Specialist
jobs.description:
Overall Purpose and Objective of Position

The Lead Logistics Specialist serves as the subject matter expert for bulk food-grade transportation operations at a large integrated oilseeds processing facility. This role provides leadership in transportation planning, carrier strategy, freight risk management, and supply chain optimization. The position is responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives, influencing logistics strategy, mentoring team members, and ensuring operational excellence across inbound and outbound transportation activities. The Lead Logistics Specialist partners closely with commercial, operations, quality, and logistics teams to identify opportunities that improve service, reduce costs, mitigate risk, and support business growth, with a strong commitment to safety, sustainability, and customer service.

Primary Responsibilities / Essential Functions

• Lead freight procurement, transportation strategy, and logistics execution to ensure cost-effective, efficient, and reliable movement of products.
• Manage transportation planning, scheduling, inventory positioning, and shipment execution to support customer requirements and on-time delivery performance.

jobs.title: Project Manager 2
jobs.description:
At RES, we’re looking for purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about restoration and sustainability, and who want their work to make a lasting environmental impact. Our team members go above and beyond, bringing initiative, integrity, and a strong work ethic to every project. Collaboration is key—we thrive on teamwork, open communication, and diverse perspectives. In a field that constantly changes, we value those who are resilient, adaptable, and resourceful in the face of challenges. If you're intellectually curious, eager to learn, and ready to help restore ecosystems and protect natural resources, you’ll find your place here.

We are looking for a Project Manager II to join our growing team. You’ll work alongside industry experts and local partners to help deliver regulatory-driven restoration projects that support both ecological and economic goals.

You’ll be based out of our Onsite Field office near Antioch, IL. working with multi-disciplinary teams that include scientists, engineers, construction professionals, and subcontractors. Future projects could warrant more travel up to 50%.

Why You’ll Love This Job

• You’ll lead high-impact ecological projects that drive measurable change

• You’ll gain autonomy while being backed by a supportive, mission-driven team

• You’ll help shape how projects are delivered by applying RES Best Management Practices

• You’ll work in a collaborative environment that values problem-solving and innovation

• You’ll see your projects evolve from concept to field implementation—and feel the difference you’re making

Minimum Qualification:

• Min 5 years working as a construction Quality Control Manager in Heavy Civil, Environmental, Ecological Restoration, or Stream Restoration projects.

• Experience leading USACE or NAVFAC construction projects or equivalent federal agencies with ecology focused deliverables.

• Familiarity with USACE quality control requirements, including the three-phase control process.

• 5+ years in ecological restoration or equivalent fields of work.

• Current USACE/NAVFAC Construction Quality Management certification, or the ability to obtain the certification before beginning work.

• Experience reviewing and documenting earthwork, excavation, drainage, stream restoration, culvert installation, erosion control, seeding, planting, and habitat restoration activities.

What You day to day will look like:

• RES is a team-oriented company. Our project managers are responsible and accountable to our teams and projects. We expect Project Managers to lead alongside our site and crew managers.

• This is a job-focused position. This position will be expected to report to the field office, with the current project focus in Lake County, IL.

• Supporting internal and external contracting teams to deliver high-quality ecological solutions that meet our clients' expectations. This may include work planning, scheduling equipment, internal staff, or subcontracting teams. It can also require documenting work through as-built documents, field data collection, daily quality control reports, inspection records, testing documentation, deficiency logs, submittal logs, and progress of payment support.

• Strong understanding of construction sequencing, surveying and layout, material testing, compaction requirements, and environmental protection measures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to identify and resolve quality issues before they affect the project schedule or final acceptance.

• Ability to work independently in a field-based construction environment and maintain a professional working relationship with the USACE project team.

• All of the above with a strong understanding of ecological restoration processes

• Experience working on ecological restoration, mitigation, or conservation projects

• Familiarity with regulatory processes, such as wetlands permitting or environmental compliance

• Experience coordinating subcontractors or vendors in a project setting

• Ability to identify problems in the field and suggest solutions independently

jobs.title: Floor Supervisor
jobs.description:
TerrAscend Corp. is a leading TSX-listed company with operations across North America, including Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Maryland, Ohio, and California through TerrAscend Growth Corp., as well as retail operations in Canada. 
TerrAscend operates The Apothecarium and other dispensary retail locations, along with scaled cultivation, processing, and manufacturing facilities across its core markets. Our portfolio includes well-known brands such as The Apothecarium, Cookies, Kind Tree, Legend, State Flower, Wana, Cuue, One, and Valhalla. 


It’s a Joint Effort
We believe that How We Work Together Matters.  Our priority is to assemble a team that believes not just in what we do but how and why we do it.  Our most successful team members know that being of service to our patients, our customers, and each other is what separates us from other organizations. Our continued success is dependent upon bringing together the brightest minds in business with best-in-class cultivation and elevated patient and customer experiences, so we continue to set the standard for the industry. 
 
Sound like weed be a good fit?  Here’s where you come in.  
 
Our next full-time Floor Supervisor will provide compassionate, friendly, and professional customer services to our patients. Floor Supervisors assist our patients and caregivers with cannabis recommendations through the process of product selection, affects, potency, dosing, methods of consumption, and administration.
 
To Be Blunt
You will be challenged to work tactically to service our patients with care and efficiency while also serving as a Leader on Duty (LOD). 
One minute you will be opening the store and prepping staff for the first few customers
The next minute you will be training a new employee on our POS system and Ecommerce platform
And the next minute assisting a patient with a difficult question around product usage
Regardless of the task, it’s critical you have strong situational awareness and EQ as you’ll work within a diverse team in the organization.
 
Where you’ll be planted
This position will be on-site in our Lancaster, PA dispensary. Our hours of operation are 9am - 8pm 7 days per week. This role will require availability during nights, weekends, and some holidays.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager(03259) - 3378 W Southport rd
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager   ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

We are hiring for closing manager shifts.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? jobs.title: VP Sales (Global)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom https://www.photoroom.com is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.






ROLE SUMMARY

We are hiring a VP of Sales to build Photoroom's global sales-led business into one of the company's major growth engines. Sales-led revenue is still early, at roughly $5-6M today. 

The foundations are real: strong enterprise customers, product-market fit in marketplaces, a growing pipeline, a large existing user base, and a team of 14. The opportunity now is to take that from early traction to a repeatable global engine, with the ambition to build towards $100M in sales-led revenue over the next few years.

This is not a role for someone looking to apply a mature SaaS playbook to an already-defined market. You will need to decide where we play, sharpen the ICP, help shape pricing, build the sales operating system, raise the bar on the team, and stay close enough to customers to personally help win the deals that matter.

One of Photoroom's biggest advantages is our existing product adoption. A core part of the job is figuring out how to turn that into enterprise growth: identifying organisations already using Photoroom, reaching the right buyers, landing strategic accounts and expanding across seats, usage, workflows and API consumption.

You will work closely with our CEO and leadership team, and partner deeply with Product, and Marketing.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Build the revenue engine

 - Own the global sales-led revenue number, strategy, and execution

 - Define and continuously sharpen our ICP, segmentation and go-to-market priorities

 - Build the next stage of our enterprise motion beyond our existing strength in marketplaces, including retailers, e-commerce brands and other high-potential segments

 - Partner on pricing and commercial strategy as we enter new segments

 - Build predictable pipeline coverage and a sales motion that scales internationally

 - Own expansion and NRR through the enterprise Customer Success organisation, treating expansion as a revenue engine rather than a support function

Raise the operating bar

 - Build a disciplined sales operating system across qualification, pipeline, forecasting, CRM hygiene and deal reviews

 - Bring strong qualification discipline, whether through MEDDPICC or an equivalent methodology, and make it something the team genuinely uses rather than a CRM checkbox

 - Improve deal size, sales-cycle efficiency and productivity

 - Use AI and automation to increase sales leverage rather than scaling headcount linearly

 - Bring clear, reliable forecasts to the CEO and leadership team

Build and lead an exceptional team

 - Lead the existing Sales and enterprise Customer Success organisation across New York and Paris

 - Assess the team quickly, develop strong performers and make the hard calls when the bar is not being met

 - Hire exceptional people and build the organisation around the sales motion we need, rather than around the structure we happen to have today

 - Create a culture of ambition, accountability, customer focus and high-quality execution

 - Coach leaders and team members while remaining close enough to the work to understand what is actually happening in deals

Lead from the front

 - Personally engage in our largest and most strategic opportunities

 - Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders and strategic partners

 - Help the team construct strong business cases and quantify customer value

 - Know when to step into a deal and when the AE should remain in the lead

 - Represent Photoroom with customers, partners, and the market

Make Sales a strong cross-functional partner

jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We are looking for a Legal and Compliance Ops Associate to join our small, but mighty Legal and Compliance team to accelerate the development of our legal and compliance programs. This is a generalist role, with an emphasis on maintaining and supporting our global portfolio of legal entities. You will create and maintain legal entities around the world, coordinate the approval and filing of annual reports and financial statements, support the administration of board meetings and corporate records,  and help with other compliance matters. You will develop processes from the ground up to create standardized procedures that help the Legal and Compliance team and Rippling operate more efficiently and effectively. If you are looking for an opportunity to join a fast-growing company and take ownership in the creation of legal infrastructure, this role is for you.

You Will

• Manage the lifecycle of our global legal entities, including entity formations, dissolutions, inter-company funding transactions, changes to directors and officers, and other corporation actions.
• Support corporate governance processes by coordinating subsidiary board meetings, including drafting agendas and preparing board and committee materials, resolutions and minutes.
• Manage annual statutory filings, including the preparation, approval and filing of annual reports and financial statements, while ensuring adherence to applicable compliance requirements.
• Collaborate with outside counsel on subsidiary governance matters, including drafting various corporate documents, such as formation documents, board and shareholder resolutions, and powers of attorney, as well as coordinating notarizations and legalizations of documents, as needed.
• Assist with Ultimate Beneficial Ownership disclosures and filings, as well as with KYC / AML requests.
• Maintain accurate corporate records and update internal entity management systems.
• Liaise with internal stakeholders, outside counsel, and various international government authorities regarding compliance-related matters.
• Support other legal and compliance projects as needed.

You Have

• Strong project management, time management, and organizational skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Entrepreneurial mindset (flexible, self-starting and hard-working).
• Ability to execute tasks at high speed.
• Sense of humor.

jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (08981)
jobs.description:
You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

Additional Requirements:

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:

What is The Role:

As the Manager, Sales Development, you will lead, coach, and scale a high-performing team of 8 Sales Development Representatives (SDRs).

You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Partners to ensure your team uncovers high-value pipeline within top-tier enterprise accounts. This role requires an analytical, hyper-organized, and operationally sound leader who thrives on building teams, driving quota accountability, and navigating complex product ecosystems.

This is a hybrid role based in our Austin, TX hub (3 days per week in-office) focused on team collaboration, coaching, and strategy alignment.

• Coaching & Skill Development: Conduct regular 1:1s and call reviews to elevate team messaging around complex technical solutions (Search, Observability, Security, and AI).

jobs.title: Member Growth Operations Associate Manager
jobs.description:
Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people.

Virta Health is seeking a Member Growth Operations Associate Manager to support the execution and continuous improvement of member communications across email, direct mail, SMS, and other campaign workflows. This is a hands-on generalist role for someone who enjoys moving between channels, learning interconnected systems, and bringing structure and accuracy to complex work.

You will partner with teammates and cross-functional stakeholders to launch and maintain campaigns, complete rigorous quality assurance, keep client-specific content and channel rules accurate, and support custom communication needs. Some workstreams will be independently owned; others will require you to step in as a flexible partner based on team priorities and capacity.




HOW YOU WILL WORK

You will succeed in this role by being dependable, curious, and adaptable. You will develop broad knowledge across Member Growth Operations, independently own assigned work, and remain ready to support teammates when priorities or volume shift. The role is designed to increase cross-functional capacity and shared knowledge across the team rather than create another single-channel specialty.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Execute and quality-check cross-channel campaigns

 - Build, update, and maintain email templates used in Braze for new client launches and ongoing member communications.

 - Complete end-to-end QA across email, direct mail, SMS, and related campaign workflows, including content, links, personalization, client-specific language, audience criteria, and technical configuration.

 - Execute direct mail campaigns through PostGrid and Cornerstone, coordinating proofs, production timelines, approvals, and vendor handoffs.

 - Support custom communication workflows by translating approved requests into executable campaign plans, configurations, and QA steps.

 - Document issues, communicate risks early, and help strengthen QA controls based on lessons learned.

Support launches and ongoing campaign operations

 - Help set up new client launches, including campaign playbooks, email and direct mail Canvases, launch configurations, and operational readiness checks.

 - Coordinate file-ingestion requirements, validation, and data syncing to Braze in partnership with implementation, data, and marketing operations stakeholders.

 - Monitor dependencies and handoffs, maintain clear project plans, and ensure launch work progresses on time and without surprises.

 - Provide backup coverage across team focus areas and take ownership of assigned campaigns or processes from intake through completion.

Maintain client content and contact-governance processes

 - Manage client-level CML updates and help maintain an organized, accurate, and scalable Braze catalog.

 - Process ‘Do Not Contact’ requests across channels, ensuring member opt-out requests are documented, validated, and applied accurately and promptly.

 - Maintain process documentation and operational sources of truth so work can be transferred and supported across the team.


90 DAY PLAN

Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following:

 - Learn the team's core tools, playbooks, QA standards, launch workflows, and client-specific CML and Do Not Contact requirements.

 - Begin independently executing routine email and direct mail campaigns, completing cross-channel QA, and owning assigned launch and custom communication work.

 - Own all new email builds across our legacy ongoing client playbooks.

 - Become dependable backup coverage across multiple workflows and deliver at least one process or documentation improvement that increases accuracy or scalability.


MUST-HAVES

 - 4+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign operations, project management, or a related field.

 - Demonstrated project management experience, including organizing dependencies, managing multiple deadlines, and driving work through completion.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined approach to quality assurance.

jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the role

The Verifications team is responsible for one of Checkr's most expansive product portfolios, an ever growing suite of screening products empowering informed decisions across our enterprise customers. Employment and education verifications, drug and occupational health screenings, reference checks, and right-to-work – are several of the products this team improves to drive growth and customer retention. Our customers place candidates into widely different roles, industries, and regulatory environments, each with distinct compliance and screening requirements, necessitating rapid product iteration across multiple fronts concurrently.

As Engineering Manager for Verifications, you'll own a wide surface area with meaningful room to make it better — improving accuracy and turnaround time, reducing manual touchpoints, and scaling how the team delivers across a complex mix of fulfillment integrations and compliance requirements. This role requires a focus on both immediate system scalability and long-term delivery process refinement. This includes near-term work on scaling data quality and automation systems to handle rapid growth, alongside strategic, longer-horizon investments in expanding coverage and building a faster, more consistent verification experience for our rapidly scaling candidate and customer base.

What you’ll do

• Lead and grow the Verifications engineering team — setting technical direction, driving performance and career development conversations, and building a hiring pipeline that strengthens the team over time

• Own the reliability and quality of a broad portfolio of fulfillment integrations — partnering closely with vendors and internal stakeholders to reduce friction, improve turnaround times, and minimize candidate and customer impact when issues arise

• Partner with Product to define and execute the roadmap across employment, education, drug and health, and compliance products — translating customer and regulatory requirements into clear engineering priorities

• Drive technical strategy for scaling a complex, integration-heavy system — making deliberate architecture decisions that improve coverage, reduce manual exceptions, and build toward a more automated and consistent verification experience

• Lead the team's adoption of AI-assisted development practices — helping engineers move faster while maintaining the quality and accuracy standards that a regulated, data-sensitive product requires

• Represent Verifications in cross-functional planning — serving as the engineering voice on team capacity, tradeoffs, and roadmap sequencing with Product, Compliance, and Engineering leadership

What you bring

• 4+ years as an engineering manager, with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams

• 8+ years as a software engineer, with strong command of service architecture, distributed systems, and system design

• Experience managing complex third-party integration environments — you’re comfortable owning reliability across systems you don’t fully control, and know how to structure teams and processes around that reality

• A track record of improving operational metrics — reducing incident frequency, improving detection time, or shipping reliability improvements in high-stakes production environments

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development and agentic coding tools — you understand how to help your team adopt these responsibly and can reason about the tradeoffs between velocity and quality they introduce

• Experience working on regulated products where data accuracy and legal compliance are non-negotiable

• Strong incident management skills — you can lead both the technical response and the stakeholder communication when things go wrong

• Ability to make prioritization decisions quickly, with a clear framework for balancing short-term reliability work against longer-term product investments

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders — Product, Operations, Compliance, and senior leadership

• A genuine investment in developing people — through career conversations, stretch assignments, and creating conditions for engineers to grow

• Humility, openness to feedback, and eagerness to learn

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes

$233,000—$274,000 USD

$197,000—$232,000 USD

What We Offer

• Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement

• 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. jobs.title: Senior Geotechnical Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Geotechnical Engineering Manager will develop and direct our organization’s geotechnical practice, overseeing complex subsurface investigations, geotechnical designs, and construction QA/QC. This person will balance high-level technical oversight with business development, mentoring staff, and managing project budgets. This role blends engineering expertise with executive leadership. This position will include opportunities to contribute to a variety of projects such as foundations, soil & rock slopes, and retaining walls related to water resources (dams, levees, floodwalls), transportation (bridge and highway), and municipal infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

• Project & Risk Management: Oversee geotechnical scopes of work, budgets, and schedules. Evaluate and mitigate risks related to soil, rock, and groundwater conditions for water resources, transportation, and municipal infrastructure projects.
• Technical Leadership: Review and oversee technical documents, to ensure a high level of accuracy and quality. Ensure all deliverables meet public agency requirements and industry codes. Provide senior geotechnical/geological engineering review and technical assistance for evaluations, design, report preparation, contract document development, and construction of projects involving the following: soil and rock mechanics; geohazards; soil/structure interaction; subsurface exploration and field testing programs; laboratory testing; geophysical methods; foundations for transportation structures; slope stability; retaining walls, excavation support systems, dewatering systems, instrumentation systems, pavement systems and earthwork operations.
• Business Development: Lead proposal efforts, interface with clients, and grow the regional geotechnical practice. Contribute to the development and execution of business plans related to the growth of our sector services; provide market and industry insight and facilitate development of marketing strategies.
• Team Leadership & Mentoring: Recruit mid- and senior staff members, and recruit, train, and mentor junior engineers and geologists. Foster cross-disciplinary collaboration with civil, structural, and environmental teams. Work with cross-functional teams on engineering projects that involve multiple sectors, fields, clients, regulators, and project sites.
• Field & Lab Operations: Direct field exploration programs, drilling operations, and soils laboratory testing.

• Education: B.S. (or M.S.) in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or Geological Engineering.
• Licensure: Professional Engineer (PE) license is required; a Structural Engineer (SE) or Certified Geotechnical Engineer (GE) license is highly preferred depending on the state.
• Experience: 10+ years of progressive geotechnical engineering experience, including prior project or team management. Ability to lead a team to meet business objectives under general supervision. Proficient self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment. Demonstrated ability to generate and manage geotechnical-related projects.
• Technical Skills: Knowledge of engineering and geologic research techniques and protocols. Possess computer skills and have experience with computer software including Microsoft Office and geotechnical specialty software. Proficiency with technical writing, office automation and communication software, technology, and tools.
• Soft Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, negotiation skills, and the ability to present complex data and project risks to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to coordinate with clients, colleagues, and third-party groups and understand requirements. Analytical mindset, detail oriented, and experience with geological research techniques required. Possess competent interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to a professional and non-professional audience.

As part of our talented staff, you will enjoy competitive pay, annual bonuses, paid health, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays; parental leave, generous 401(k) match, access to HSA & FSAs, flexible schedule, annual HEI logo apparel and more.

Our position as part of this international network gives us a key advantage over other agencies in terms of the scale of our reach and depth of our expertise.

Unparalleled in scale and expertise, we connect a full suite of Advisory, Medical, Marketing/Communications, Patient and Stakeholder Engagement, and Biotech services to reimagine clients' challenges into opportunities.

About the Role

We have an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Account Director to join one of our teams at Ashfield MedComms. As Account Director, you will serve as the senior client lead, providing strategic oversight and operational leadership across a high-profile medical publications and medical affairs portfolio. You will ensure seamless delivery of congress and journal publications as well as strategic medical affairs initiatives while upholding the highest standards of scientific rigor, compliance, and process excellence.

You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, global authors, and leading experts. Bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex, multi-stakeholder programs.

• Proven success in client relationship management, strategic consultation, and account growth.

jobs.title: Marketing and Executive Support Coordinator
jobs.description:
UASI is looking for a highly organized, proactive and tech-savvy Marketing and Executive Support Coordinator who enjoys variety, takes ownership and is willing to jump in wherever needed.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing, office management and leadership support. Some days may include developing social media content, coordinating an employee spotlight or preparing materials for an executive meeting. Others may involve setting up the office for a Board meeting, creating a presentation, helping organize a company event or packing materials for an upcoming trade show.

We are looking for someone who likes being the person who helps make things happen. This is a hands-on, high-trust role for someone who can manage multiple priorities, work comfortably with senior leaders and take responsibility for important details without needing constant direction. As they learn the business, there will be opportunities to take on additional marketing and project responsibilities.

Marketing Support

• Manage the day-to-day execution of UASI’s social media presence, including planning, scheduling and publishing content across company channels.

• Develop social media content for new hire announcements, employee spotlights, recognition weeks, company news, events and other timely topics.

• Use broader themes, source material and input from internal leaders to draft engaging, on-brand copy.

• Maintain the social media calendar and ensure content is developed, approved and published on schedule.

• Monitor company social channels and identify comments or messages requiring follow-up.

• Support updates to marketing materials and digital content; assist with email marketing, HubSpot and website updates as capabilities grow.

• Proofread and quality-check marketing materials, presentations and other content.

• Provide backup support for trade show logistics, including assembling, packing and shipping event materials.

Leadership and Administrative Support

• Provide administrative and project support to the leadership team, including the CEO.

• Assist with special projects, follow-ups and coordination across multiple stakeholders.

• Organize materials and logistics for annual planning, Board meetings, client meetings and other leadership events.

• Assist with presentation development, formatting, proofreading and quality assurance.

• Coordinate occasional complex or large-group meetings and track requested action items.

• Handle confidential business, personnel and strategic information with discretion and sound judgment.

• Pitch in on priorities that do not fit neatly into a traditional job description.

Office Management

• Coordinate day-to-day needs of UASI’s corporate office, including office and meeting supplies.

• Arrange meeting rooms, meals and other logistics for leadership and Board meetings, planning sessions and visitors.

• Help keep the office prepared and professional for employees, guests and company events.

• Coordinate occasional office lunches and employee activities; work with vendors and internal resources on routine office needs.

• Anticipate upcoming needs and address them before they become urgent.

What We Are Looking For

• Approximately 3–5 years of experience in marketing coordination, executive or administrative support, office management, project coordination, events or a related role.

• Excellent organization, attention to detail, follow-through, writing, editing and proofreading skills.

• Ability to develop polished social media content from basic direction, source information or company updates.

• Comfort with technology and the ability to learn new systems quickly; proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Experience with social media platforms and scheduling tools; HubSpot, Canva and website content management experience is a plus.

• Ability to juggle marketing, administrative and hands-on work, exercise sound judgment and interact confidently with executives, employees, clients and partners.

• A proactive, resourceful approach and discretion with confidential information.

The Person Who Will Thrive in This Role

You like being the person others can count on to make things happen. You think ahead, can move a loosely defined assignment forward and are equally comfortable drafting a social post, polishing a presentation and unpacking trade show materials. You enjoy learning new tools, work independently and know when to ask questions or escalate an issue.

UASI provides a growth environment with opportunities for high achievers to be rewarded. We offer a full benefits package with compensation aligned to contribution and success. Don't miss out on this great opportunity!

At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value, and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences, and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be apart of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

As a Delivery Expert you are the mechanism for delivering fast and delectably delicious pizzas to our hungry customers. As such, enthusiastic customer communication, positive personality, punctuality and sense of urgency are essential to success in this role. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.

• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

Additional Requirements:

• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Project Manager | $110K-$130K + Remote | Inc. 5000 Award-Winning, High-Growth Coaching Company
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager is responsible for turning company priorities into clear plans and driving them through successful completion.

Working closely with leadership, you'll lead projects across Marketing, Copywriting, Marketing Automation, Customer Operations, Events, Coaching, Product, Sales, and external partners.

Projects may include coaching and course launches, webinars, book campaigns, sales funnels, email campaigns, digital products, live events, and other major company initiatives.

You'll need to understand how all of these pieces work together, what needs to happen and when, who owns each deliverable, what depends on what, and where a delay could put a launch or business objective at risk.

This is not an administrative project management position. Our client needs an experienced operator who can take an outcome, build the plan required to achieve it, lead multiple departments through execution, anticipate problems, hold people accountable, and relentlessly close loops until the intended result has been delivered.

Responsibilities

• • Own multiple projects at once across coaching and course launches, webinars, book campaigns, marketing campaigns, sales funnels, digital products, live and virtual events, and other company priorities.
• • Personally build and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, dependencies, milestones, ownership, and workflows within Asana or similar.
• • Lead projects across Marketing, Copywriting, Marketing Automation, Customer Operations, Events, Coaching, Product, Sales, leadership, and external partners.
• • Drive revenue generating launches involving webinars, sales funnels, email campaigns, landing pages, copy, CRM and marketing automation, affiliates, promotional windows, testing, and hard launch deadlines.

• • Validate completion by reviewing critical deliverables, confirming requirements have been met, performing final QA checks, and closing execution gaps before launch.
• • Assess the existing Project Management environment and Asana setup, preserve what works, improve what doesn't, and lead a Project Coordinator while creating greater visibility and accountability across the company.

• 5+ years of hands on Project Management, launch management, product/program management, or similar experience in a fast moving organization.
• Experience leading complex projects across multiple established departments, with the ability to drive accountability, manage competing dependencies, and keep teams on track without becoming the individual executor for every delayed deliverable.
• Experience inside a creator led coaching or personal development business that sells courses, memberships, high ticket coaching, digital products, or live events through direct response marketing.
• Direct experience personally managing revenue generating launches such as coaching or course launches, webinars, book campaigns, sales funnels, email campaigns, affiliate campaigns, or other major promotional initiatives.
• Experience with affiliate marketing, high ticket offers, memberships, masterminds, book launches, or other creator led offers.
• Strong understanding of direct response marketing and launch workflows, including sales funnels, email campaigns, landing pages, webinars, CRM and marketing automation, promotional windows, testing, and hard launch deadlines.
• Experience managing live events (in the thousands of attendees) and understanding the full event lifecycle, including marketing, promotion, vendors, logistics, timelines, and execution.
• Track record of leading multiple departments in remote settings.
• Exceptional attention to detail. Your work is clean, accurate, and on time, and you don't leave loops open.

jobs.title: Client Support Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us:
DailyPay is the leader in On-Demand Pay, helping employers modernize how people get their pay. DailyPay serves more than 1,900 employers and over 6 million employees, including many of the world's most recognized brands. By providing real-time access to earned pay and financial wellness tools, DailyPay helps employees manage their finances and helps employers attract and retain talent. DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work.. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center. http://www.dailypay.com/press


THE ROLE:

The Client Support Specialist is an integral member of the Customer Support Operations organization, responsible for delivering high-touch, responsive operational support to DailyPay’s corporate HR and Payroll administrators. Working within centralized ticketing systems like Zendesk and Jira, this role diagnoses technical inquiries, guides clients through platform functionality, and executes critical outbound operations to maintain excellent account health. You will follow a structured daily schedule, collaborating cross-functionally with technical teams to ensure seamless data exchanges and uphold rigorous client experience quality standards.


HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

 - Queue Management: Resolve inbound client inquiries and technical support requests across phone and email channels via Zendesk in a timely, high-quality manner

 - Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose backend system anomalies and investigate technical client platform questions using internal databases and administrative tools

 - Payroll & Data Auditing: Partner with client admins to address operational data exchange topics, including sFTP file processing, data anomalies, payroll calendars, and net earnings validation

 - Internal Ticket Governance: Orchestrate cross-functional resolution workflows within Jira, liaising with Client Success and Engineering teams to escalate and close client-specific issues

 - Quality Assurance Adherence: Maintain outstanding client satisfaction metrics by strictly adhering to established team quality standards, response timelines, and daily operational schedules

 - Cross-Functional Insight Sharing: Capture, synthesize, and report recurring client feedback and platform friction points to Product and Engineering teams to drive systematic platform improvements

 - Client Consultation: Attend scheduled client alignment meetings alongside account teams to provide technical insight regarding employee eligibility configurations and product functionality

 - Operational Availability: Participate in a structured on-call rotation during designated weekends and holidays to resolve urgent, time-sensitive client escalations outside of standard business hours


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM:

 - Technical Acumen: Demonstrated proficiency working with modern ticketing environments (e.g., Zendesk, Jira) and basic familiarity with data platforms or file transfer setups (e.g., sFTP, SQL, Metabase)

 - Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical HR and payroll contacts

 - Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and intuitive problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to maintain composure and detail-orientation under operational pressure

 - Agility & Learning Speed: A fast learner with the capacity to rapidly achieve subject matter expertise in evolving software products, backend tooling, and fintech configurations

 - Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Communications, or a related field; or equivalent practical operational experience.

 - Exceptional health, vision, and dental care

 - Opportunity for equity ownership

 - Life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability

 - Employee Assistance Program

 - Employee Resource Groups

 - Fun company outings and events

 - Unlimited PTO

We believe that by checking our own assumptions and staying curious about the experiences of others, we arrive at better, more innovative results.

jobs.title: Operations Manager | Boston
jobs.description:
About Blank Street

At Blank Street, we’re on a mission to become the defining food and beverage brand of our generation. From the very beginning, we’ve set out to add a spark to ordinary experiences through elevated products, attention-to-detail, and a commitment to making every moment memorable. We’re motivated by the millions of customers we serve across cities, and know that our potential is unlimited. It all starts with our people and their commitment to make magic happen each and every day.

Like the sound of this? Keep reading.

Start Something Extraordinary…

As an Operations Manager at Blank Street, you are the ultimate leader of an entire area of 5+ stores and the General Managers who lead them.

That means your greatest responsibility is growing people. You will hire, coach and develop an A* team of GMs, helping them become confident leaders who build engaged, high-performing teams across our stores.
You are also the strategic mind behind your stores: you will own your area's PnL and decide how to plan, prioritize and follow through, so your stores get better day by day. In a fast-moving and constantly evolving business, you will create clarity, build capability, and foster a culture of accountability, hospitality and continuous improvement.

You'll report to the Director of Operations and work closely with the rest of our Field Leadership team. Together, you'll help scale the next generation of leaders while driving an exceptional experience for both our teams and our customers.

What You'll Own

Be Our Ultimate Hospitality Leader

• Make the standards stick: Coach your GMs to build the systems, behaviors and processes that keep our hospitality standards high every shift, whether you're in the store or not.

• Hold the bar: Check standards across your area through regular store visits and data, and hold GMs accountable for closing gaps fast.

• Jump in where it counts: Take an active role in turning around struggling stores and launching new stores in your area.

Run a Tight PnL

• Plan for demand: Take quarterly sales forecasts from HQ, translate them store by store and make sure every GM knows what's coming (growth, slowdowns, seasonality, new openings nearby).

• Build the labor plan: Set labor targets a quarter out, including headcount and transfers between stores, and coach GMs to build rotas against them.

• Calibrate inventory: Help GMs calibrate inventory to forecast demand, and set clear guardrails so no store is badly overstocked or running short.

Build and Develop an A-Team

• Develop your GMs: Grow GMs into future leaders through our training pathways, regular 1:1s and direct feedback.

• Own the talent pipeline: Calibrate hiring and promotion decisions across your area and set quarterly succession targets from barista to GM, so every store has its next leader ready.

Who We’re Looking For

• Strategic planner: you know how to plan a quarter ahead and how to turn priorities into plans your GMs can act on.

• Excellent communicator: you know how to cut through the noise and are sharp in writing (Slack, Notion, email) and confident in speech (area meetings, workshops).

Availability Requirements

Full Time: 50 hours per week, 5 days of availability required and must be available to work 2 peak days (usually weekend days, weekend as described as Friday, Saturday, Sunday)

Benefits & Perks

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a competitive total rewards package, which may include benefits, paid time off, and other perks.
