jobs.title: Domino's Customer Service Rep (03525)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality, hustle and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences, and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be apart of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Domino's crew member, you are often the first person to welcome and interface with Domino’s customers. As such, enthusiastic customer communication, positive personality, and punctuality are essential to success in this role. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! Additional duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, and make sound ethical judgments in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders with a smile!

• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.

• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.

You must be at least 16 years of age

Must pass a Criminal Background Check

jobs.title: Senior Account Director
jobs.description:
About Ashfield MedComms

Ashfield MedComms is a global leader in the medical communications space with a portfolio of clients across medical affairs, publications and commercial. We are part of Inizio Medical, which also includes ApotheCom, Nucleus Global and MEDiSTRAVA. Our position as part of this international network gives us a key advantage over other agencies in terms of the scale of our reach and depth of our expertise.

More broadly, Inizio Medical is part of Inizio, whose mission is to be THE strategic partner for health and life sciences companies. Unparalleled in scale and expertise, we connect a full suite of Advisory, Medical, Marketing/Communications, Patient and Stakeholder Engagement, and Biotech services to reimagine clients' challenges into opportunities.

About the Role

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Account Director to join Ashfield MedComms. In this role, you’ll provide strategic and operational leadership across a portfolio of high-profile publications and medical affairs accounts, serving as a trusted partner to senior client stakeholders and leading Client Services teams to deliver exceptional work.

You’ll oversee complex, multi-stakeholder programs spanning global publications and broader medical affairs initiatives, ensuring scientific rigor, operational excellence, and strong financial performance. As a senior member of the Client Services team, you’ll also play an important role in developing our people, growing existing partnerships, and supporting new business opportunities.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Provide strategic and operational leadership across multiple publications and medical affairs accounts, ensuring high-quality, compliant delivery.

• Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, providing strategic counsel and proactive solutions to complex challenges.

• Oversee publication programs, including abstracts, posters, manuscripts, congress activities, and related deliverables, alongside broader medical affairs initiatives.

• Partner closely with Scientific Services and cross-functional teams to develop and deliver strategic medical communications plans aligned with client objectives.

• Champion operational best practices, identifying opportunities to strengthen delivery, improve efficiencies, and support organic account growth.

• Own account financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, profitability, reconciliation, invoicing, and SOW development.

• Lead and develop multiple Client Services team members.

• Lead and support business development activities, including proposals, RFPs/RFIs, presentations, budgets, and onboarding of new business.

• Partner with senior Client Services leadership on resourcing, team development, training, and new service offerings.

• Ensure teams maintain strong cross-functional partnerships and effectively manage risks, priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

• Extensive medical communications agency experience, with strong expertise across publications and medical affairs.

• Demonstrated success leading multiple complex client accounts and providing strategic counsel to senior stakeholders.

• Strong knowledge of publication planning and delivery, medical affairs communications, industry standards, and compliance requirements.

• Proven experience leading and developing Client Services teams, including managing managers and/or multiple direct reports.

• Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, profitability, SOW development, and account growth.

• Experience leading or contributing to new business development, including proposals, pitches, and RFP/RFI responses.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

• Experience with platforms such as iEnvision, Veeva, or similar systems.

Benefits

At Ashfield, compensation is more than just a base salary. We offer a comprehensive bonus plan and benefit programs including for medical, dental, and vision, a generous 401k match, vacation, sick and personal days. Generous company holiday plan and additional benefits for those building as well as expanded paid leave for new parents.

Our Pledge

We appreciate the importance of having a workforce that reflects the various communities in which we operate, and our goal is to create an inclusive environment where diverse employees want to work and where they can flourish.

Ashfield MedComms is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Inizio are considered without regards to age, ancestry, color, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Further, pursuant to applicable local ordinances, Inizio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Inizio is an equal opportunity employer M/F/V/D. We appreciate your interest in our company, however; only qualified candidates will be considered.

Ashfield MedComms is part of Inizio Medical. Inizio is a strategic partner for health and life sciences with a full suite of medical, marketing, advisory and engagement services.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation

$130,000—$160,000 USD

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

jobs.title: Founding Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Neuroscale

Neuroscale AI is building an AI Recruiting Operating System - one unified platform for the talent organization, from first touch through evaluation and hire. Our flagship platform, Arbi, helps companies discover, engage, screen, and evaluate talent at scale using AI-native intelligence, automation, and data. We have invested deeply in the product. Now we are building the repeatable growth engine that brings it to market.



About the Role

We are hiring a Founding Performance Marketing Lead to own performance and growth marketing from the ground up. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build the machine - not inherit one. 

You will own the path from first impression to click to conversion to qualified pipeline to closed ARR. That includes paid acquisition, creative testing, landing pages, attribution, funnel instrumentation, conversion-rate optimization, audience discovery, and early product-led growth experiments.

You will work directly with Neuroscale's founders and partner closely with Product, Design, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will have the autonomy to test quickly, scale what works, stop what does not, and turn learning into repeatable playbooks.



What You'll Own

1. Build and scale the paid acquisition engine

Launch, manage, and optimize acquisition across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, retargeting, and emerging channels. Personally manage meaningful media spend and make channel  decisions based on pipeline quality, acquisition economics, and revenue - not vanity metrics.

2. Turn creative into a growth system

Build a high-velocity testing engine across short-form video, UGC, founder-led creative, static ads, customer proof, use-case creative, case studies, and landing-page concepts. Develop a repeatable process for creative briefs, production, testing, learning, and iteration.

3. Own the conversion funnel

Build and continuously improve the journey from ad to landing page to demo or trial to activation. Create and ship landing pages without waiting on a large web team, and work with Product and Design to remove friction from high-intent conversion paths.

4. Make measurement and attribution decision-grade

Own campaign tracking, UTMs, pixels, events, conversion APIs, CRM campaign logic, attribution models, dashboards, and funnel reporting. Create a clear view of what is producing qualified pipeline, what is wasting spend, and where conversion is breaking down.

5. Run a disciplined experimentation program

Design and execute continuous A/B and multivariate tests across hooks, creative, copy, audiences, offers, landing pages, CTAs, forms, demo flows, and channel mix. Maintain an experiment backlog and use data to decide what to scale, iterate, or kill.

6. Discover and codify our best audiences

Identify the ICP signals, personas, use cases, pain points, messages, offers, and targeting strategies that consistently produce high-quality opportunities. Turn those findings into reusable audience and messaging playbooks for Marketing and Sales.

7. Help shape product-led growth

Partner with Product and Revenue on activation, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid pathways, in-product prompts, lifecycle nudges, and other early PLG loops that can complement the sales-led motion.

8. Automate for leverage

Use AI, no-code/low-code tools, enrichment, workflow automation, and light scripting to increase testing velocity and reduce repetitive work. Build a marketing operating system that can test 20 thoughtful ideas where a traditional team might test two.



The Numbers You'll Care About

 1. Qualified Pipeline 

 2. CAC / CAC Payback 

 3. CPL / Cost per Qualified Lead

 4. ARR Sourced / Influenced

 5. Conversion Rate 

 6. LTV / CAC 

 7. Pipeline Velocity 

 8. Experiment Win Rate

Clicks, CTR, engagement, and reach matter only when they help explain the economics of acquiring customers and creating revenue.



Who We're Looking For

 - 4-8+ years of hands-on performance marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, HR Tech, recruiting technology, or another high-growth technology category.

 - A track record of personally managing and scaling approximately $50K-$250K+ per month in paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, or comparable channels - and translating that spend into qualified pipeline and revenue.

 - Deep hands-on experience inside ad platforms. You can build campaigns, audiences, conversion tracking, creative tests, budgets, bids, and optimization logic yourself.

 - Demonstrated ability to connect channel spend to downstream funnel performance, opportunity creation, pipeline, and ARR.

 - Strong command of funnel economics, including CPL, CAC, LTV, CAC payback, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marginal acquisition efficiency.

 - Experience building and improving landing pages, forms, demo flows, or trial experiences with a strong CRO mindset.

 - Strong creative instincts and copy judgment. You can diagnose why a message or creative concept is working - not merely report that CTR changed.

 - Experience testing video, UGC, creator-led, founder-led, or short-form paid creative.

 - Comfort with analytics, dashboards, CRM data, experimentation, attribution, and imperfect early-stage datasets.

 - Ability to move quickly from hypothesis to launch to data to insight to the next test.

 - Strong written communication and the ability to translate customer pain into clear, high-converting messaging.

 - A builder mentality: high ownership, low ego, strong judgment, and a preference for creating the playbook rather than waiting for one.

Bonus Points If You Have

 - Built performance marketing from near-zero at an early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS company.

 - Scaled one or more paid channels into a predictable source of qualified pipeline while maintaining disciplined acquisition economics.

 - Experience in HR Tech, recruiting technology, AI, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or another complex B2B category.

 - Built a UGC, creator, customer-proof, or founder-led creative program that materially improved paid performance.

 - Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce; Webflow or Framer; GA4; Segment; Mixpanel or Amplitude; Clay; Zapier or Make; and modern attribution or ad-tracking tools.

 - Built lightweight automations, scripts, dashboards, or AI-assisted workflows yourself.

 - Worked with Product teams on PLG, free-trial, self-service, lifecycle, or activation experiments.

 - Used AI tools systematically to accelerate research, creative production, analysis, personalization, and experimentation.



You'll Thrive Here If

 - You want meaningful ownership and are energized by a blank sheet of paper.

 - You enjoy being in the campaigns, creative, landing pages, dashboards, and funnel - not only managing vendors.

 - You are comfortable being accountable for qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

 - You prefer fast, instrumented experiments over long planning cycles.

 - You can balance speed with analytical rigor and know when the data is strong enough to act.

 - You are resourceful and can ship with a small team while building systems that scale.



What Success Looks Like

 - A repeatable paid acquisition engine is producing qualified demand at increasingly predictable economics.

 - Campaign-to-CRM attribution provides a credible view from spend through opportunity, pipeline, and revenue.

 - Creative and landing-page experiments are shipping every week with documented learnings.

 - Neuroscale has a clear picture of its highest-converting ICPs, personas, messages, offers, and channel combinations.

 - Landing-page, demo/trial, and funnel conversion rates are improving through systematic experimentation.

 - CAC and payback are understood by channel and audience, with clear thresholds for scaling spend.

 - A measurable content and creative engine supports paid acquisition rather than operating as a separate activity stream.

 - Marketing, Product, Sales, and Revenue Operations share a common funnel definition and growth scorecard.

 - A documented growth playbook compounds as spend, headcount, and market coverage increase.



Why Neuroscale

Build at the moment growth becomes the priority. The product foundation is in place. The opportunity now is to build the acquisition engine that can turn strong technology into a category-defining company.

Founding-level ownership. You will not be optimizing someone else's mature playbook. The systems, experiments, and operating cadence you create can become the foundation of Neuroscale's future growth organization.

Direct access to the founders. Work closely with company leadership with very little organizational friction between a strong idea and testing it in market.

AI-native environment. You will market an AI company inside a team that expects AI to be embedded in how research, creative, analysis, automation, and decision-making get done.

High autonomy with clear accountability. This is a high-trust role for someone who wants the freedom to move quickly and the responsibility to own measurable outcomes.

A path to broader growth leadership. This role is designed to expand with results, with a fast path toward Head of Growth as the company scales.



The Opportunity

Most performance marketing roles ask you to improve an existing engine by 10-20%. This role gives you the chance to build the engine.

The campaigns you launch, audiences you discover, creative systems you create,  attribution infrastructure you establish, and growth loops you uncover can define how Neuroscale acquires customers for years.



Compensation & Growth

This is a founding-level, high-impact role with compensation designed to align with measurable growth and long-term value creation. Specific base compensation, performance incentives, equity or long-term participation, and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates and finalized based on experience, location, and employment structure.

The role is designed to create a path toward broader Head of Growth leadership as Neuroscale scales.



How We Hire

We value evidence of outcomes over polished marketing language. Strong candidates should be prepared to walk through campaigns they personally built, the economics behind them, what they tested, what failed, what they changed, and how those decisions affected pipeline or revenue.

 - Introductory conversation focused on fit, ownership, and growth-stage experience.

 - Deep dive into one or two performance programs you personally operated.

 - Practical working session or case discussion focused on audience, creative, funnel, and measurement strategy.

 - Final conversation with the founders on scope, operating style, and growth mandate.



Equal Opportunity

Neuroscale AI is committed to building a team based on capability, potential, and impact. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

Action Property Management is seeking a Compliance Coordinator to join team at the Travis Ranch community in Forney, TX.
 
Summary:
The Compliance Coordinator performs day-to-day compliance activities for the community, including processing and tracking violations, maintaining accurate documentation, following compliance matters through resolution, and supporting consistent enforcement of the association’s governing documents. The role also oversees self-help activities and related vendor coordination, assists with leasing compliance, and provides timely follow-up and reporting to management. Communication with homeowners is an important part of the role, including clarifying violations and explaining corrective actions. The ideal candidate is observant, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable engaging with residents in a courteous and professional manner.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee the self-help compliance process by documenting, printing and confirming that notices are posted on homeowner’s doors.
Manage self-help vendor scheduling and follow-up.
Save all self-help ‘cured’ emails/photos to the homeowner unit folder.
Submit compliance violation fines weekly to homeowner ledgers.
With GM oversight, track unauthorized leasing activity and issue violations on a recurring 10-day cycle, including detailed research to verify when homes appear to be leased in violation of the association’s governing documents.
Issue courtesy notices, violation letters, and follow-up communications in accordance with association policy and timelines.
Track and manage open violations through resolution, maintaining accurate and organized records.
Track and manage towing records.
Communicate with residents in a professional and respectful manner when addressing compliance matters.
Provide backup support for regular community patrols to identify and document potential violations of the association’s CC&Rs, Rules, and Regulations.
When providing backup patrol coverage, capture and upload clear, detailed photos and notes of potential violations using the association’s compliance software.
Prepare compliance reports for management and board meetings as requested.
Collaborate with the General Manager, Assistant Manager, and Administrative staff to ensure consistent enforcement and timely follow-up.
Attend board or committee meetings as needed to provide compliance updates or clarification.
Assist with other administrative duties or special projects as assigned.
 
Position and Work Environment:
This position requires onsite presence at the assigned location.
The work environment emphasizes a collaborative atmosphere with open communication and mutual respect among team members.
Overtime requires approval.
Required Skills / Abilities:
Previous experience in property management, community association management or code enforcement preferred.
Strong attention to detail and ability to remain objective when assessing potential violations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and mobile inspection/reporting tools.
Must possess a valid state driver’s license, insurance, and a reliable personal vehicle to provide back-up coverage for the Compliance Specialist.
Ability to work independently and maintain confidentiality.
May require flexibility for occasional evening or weekend inspections.
Education / Certifications:
High School diploma or equivalent.
Physical Requirements:
Ability to drive, walk, and perform inspections outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Capable of lifting up to 25 pounds as needed.

jobs.title: Community Strategy Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:  Community Strategy Enablement Manager - Florida

Department: Customer Success

About the Role:

The Community Strategy Enablement Manager will provide the operational and analytical backbone that allows the Community Strategy Leadership to focus on designing and executing on a cross-functional vision for the connection between our customers and their community partners. This role ensures that our community strategy is consistently executed across Customer Success and Sales by standardizing processes, managing escalation tracking in Salesforce, and coordinating with RevOps and Analytics to capture the right data. By supporting and tracking customer escalations, the Community Strategy Enablement Manager demonstrates the measurable effectiveness of escalation campaigns and adoption efforts.

This role sits at the intersection of process design, analytics, and consultative enablement. You’ll ensure internal teams have the tools, insights, and frameworks needed to engage partners, resolve escalations, and drive adoption at scale. By connecting community strategy with data and performance measurement, you’ll help demonstrate the effectiveness of our engagement efforts both internally and with customers.

What You'll Do:

Internal Enablement

• Serve as a consultative partner to Customer Success Managers, supporting escalation reviews and building network engagement plans for new and priority customers.

• Collaborate with Sales and Implementation teams to align on customer onboarding and embed community processes early.

Retention & Engagement

• Drive retention across assigned customer accounts.

• Actively partner with community-based organizations to strengthen relationships and address shared goals.

• Collaborate closely with Marketing and Revenue Operations teams to align strategies and ensure community-focused objectives are met.

• Foster meaningful connections that enhance customer and community outcomes.

Operational Process

• Maintain SOPs, playbooks, and triage processes for consistent handling of community escalations.

• Facilitate weekly escalation review meetings and track follow-up actions across teams.

Analytics & Insights

• Track, and report escalation campaign metrics in Salesforce.

• Monitor adoption, network health, and partner engagement data, for key customers and geographies, as needed

• Manage customer surveys following escalations to measure satisfaction and demonstrate effectiveness of resolution efforts.

• Be innovative & think outside the box when it comes to developing new models that drive user adoption

Communication and Events

• Work with Marketing on Community-facing materials

• Support Community-focused Marketing events.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

• 3+ years of experience in customer success, community engagement, implementation, account management, public health, human services, social services, or a related customer-facing role.

• Experience working with state or local government agencies, community-based organizations (CBOs), nonprofits, healthcare organizations, or other organizations serving vulnerable populations.

• Demonstrated success building relationships across multiple stakeholder groups, including customers, community partners, government agencies, or cross-functional internal teams.

• Experience managing complex projects or programs that require coordination across multiple organizations, competing priorities, and changing timelines.

• Strong analytical and operational skills with experience using data to measure outcomes, identify opportunities, and improve processes.

• Experience documenting processes, developing playbooks or standard operating procedures, or driving operational consistency across teams.

• Experience using CRM or case management platforms (Salesforce preferred) and comfort learning new technology platforms.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes, priorities, and customer needs continue to develop.

Our Mission:

Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. They witnessed firsthand the barriers and inefficiencies in trying to navigate health and social services, and set out to improve that experience for veterans and their families. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions:

• This position is remote, U.S. based. Candidates in the state of Florida are preferred.

• This position may require 30-50% travel

• The target pay range for this role is: $75,000-$85,000. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies, as well as location.

Benefits provided by Unite Us:

We offer insurance to team members and eligible partners and dependents, including unlimited virtual mental health and acute medical visits.

Wellness

Mental health benefits, such as the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness platform subscription, are available to all team members.

Employee Resource Groups

Spending Accounts

We offer tax-advantaged health savings accounts (HSAs), flexible spending accounts (FSAs), and commuter benefits.

401(k) + Employer Match

Enjoy matching, immediate vesting and financial wellness resources

Additional Benefits

Life and AD&D - a company paid benefit, with the option to purchase additional coverage for yourself and your dependents

Disability Coverage

Accident Insurance

As part of this work at home job, we will provide you with all the necessary equipment to perform your duties, including a computer, mouse, keyboard as well as other items on our approved list of WFH supplies.

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Link Solutions is seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to join our team in supporting our strategic growth initiatives and enterprise capability development in McLean, VA.

• Must be a U.S. citizen
• Must have ten (10+) years experience leading technical solution development for large, complex federal pursuits
• Must be on-site in McLean, VA every Wednesday; local candidates preferred

The Principal Solutions Architect will lead the development of innovative, mission-focused technical solutions supporting priority federal and defense pursuits. This individual will serve as the technical lead across capture, proposal, business development, operational, and engineering teams, helping shape differentiated solutions and long-term technical strategy.

The role requires a forward-thinking technologist with deep expertise across enterprise IT, cloud, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, AI/ML, automation, and modernization initiatives. In addition, a demonstrated ability to rapidly evaluate emerging technologies, translate them into practical mission capabilities, and develop differentiated technical solutions supporting both strategic pursuits and corporate capability development.

• Lead the development of innovative, compliant, and executable technical solutions supporting strategic federal and defense opportunities.
• Serve as the technical lead for priority captures and proposals, partnering with capture, business development, proposal, operational, and engineering teams.
• Translate customer mission requirements into differentiated technical architectures, delivery strategies, and scalable operational solutions.
• Drive technical solutioning sessions, architecture reviews, and collaborative workshops with internal and external stakeholders.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

Preferred:

• Experience supporting large federal growth organizations and strategic capture programs.
• Experience with cloud modernization, cybersecurity transformation, AI/ML, DevSecOps, and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
• Experience supporting high-value, competitive federal pursuits and proposal efforts.

Link Solutions Inc. offers a competitive compensation and benefits package to include paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, company-paid long and short-term disability, life insurance, referral bonuses, relocation incentive program, certification reimbursement program, retirement, and more.

Link Solutions, Inc. is an EOE. AA/M/F/D/V. We participate in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About the Role

You'll be the end to end technical owner of how external partners and merchants integrate with Koalafi. From the first discovery call through build, launch, and ongoing support, you're the person who designs the integration path, guides partner development teams, validates the implementation, and keeps it healthy in production. While not responsible for writing production code, you’ll play a key role in accelerating our go-to-market efforts.

You’ll deeply understand Koalafi’s technical offerings and platform architecture so that you can guide external teams to build reliable, scalable, and compliant integrations. You’ll work cross-functionally with business development, product, and engineering teams to unblock deals, expand platform support, and improve the overall merchant experience. You'll also own the operating rhythm around integrations — the recurring cross-functional meetings, our internal and external documentation, and the processes that keep the work moving.

What You'll Do

• Develop mastery of every integration we offer — the full set of features, every existing partner implementation, how each is configured, and what makes each one unique.

• Build an end-to-end understanding of Koalafi's products beyond the integration layer: how an application moves from origination through approval, checkout, and funding, and how our internal systems interact along the way.

• Own each new integration end to end; starting with Discovery and continuing through the build, QA and release of that new integration.

• Keep our existing implementations running by supporting rollouts to new merchants and partnering with sales to identify new areas of engagement.

• Be the first line of defense for any partner submitted issues, leveraging observability tools to triage and prioritize partner submitted tickets.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, and Sales to identify enhancement opportunities in existing integrations, and own those enhancements through completion.

• Continuously look for ways to improve how we work internally, and own the rollout and adoption of the improvements you design.

What You Might Take On

Beyond the day-to-day, there are open problems we'd want your help solving:

• External partner communications: How do we quickly alert partners during an outage, announce breaking changes and schedule required upgrades, and drive adoption of new features?

• Partner ticketing: Establishing a real process for partners to submit issues, and championing adoption both internally and externally.

• Manual process audit: Finding what we do by hand that Engineering could automate, where manual work is producing errors, and where we could give people meaningful time back.

About You

• Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and common integration patterns; experience with e-commerce platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento) or POS systems is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with software engineering principles and software architecture — enough to reason about how systems fit together and where a flow is likely breaking.

• Familiarity with at least one programming language (e.g., GoLang, JavaScript, Python)—enough to understand code samples, answer implementation questions, and speak confidently with developers

• Able to write SQL queries and use other troubleshooting tools (e.g. Elastic, Fullstory, Postman) to investigate issues, size impact, and make small manual changes.

• Eagerness to leverage AI tools to assist with initial triage and investigation.

• Able to translate complex technical concepts into partner-friendly language without losing depth or accuracy.

• Strong collaboration skills—you enjoy working across business, product, and engineering teams to solve real-world problems.

• Effective both independently and collaboratively, and proactive about seeking feedback.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, curious, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in dynamic partner engagements.

• A genuine problem solver who identifies gaps and pain points in existing processes and improves them; able to synthesize a partner problem into a technical solution.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in structured documentation or integration guides.

Experience

• Bachelor's degree preferred in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.

• 6+ years in a technical, client-facing role such as Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Integration Engineer, or Technical Consultant.

Location: Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.

Salary Range: $140,000-$160,000 per year (depending on experience and location)

Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.

The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

Benefits:

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 20 PTO days + 11 paid holidays

• 401(k) retirement with company matching

• Student Loan & Tuition Reimbursement

• Commuter assistance

• Parental leave (maternal + paternal)

• Inclusion and Associate Engagement Programs

Who we are & what we value:

• We focus on what’s most important

• We set clear expectations and deliver

• We embrace challenges to reach our full potential

• We ask, “How can this be better?”

• We move fast together

jobs.title: Manager, Foundation Relations
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Our vision is to grant the wish of every eligible child. Through our mission, we are uniting communities to grant life-changing wishes. As the world’s largest wish-granting organization, we strive to create a sense of community and an environment where we warmly embrace our wish families, volunteers, and colleagues.

Joining Make-A-Wish means becoming part of a mission that believes in the power of a wish.

Location:

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We do not sponsor employment visas or other immigration processes to attain or maintain employment eligibility.

Remote positions are open to applicants based anywhere in the continental U.S. Hybrid positions are open to applicants based in the Phoenix, Arizona area.

Position Summary:

The Manager, Foundation Relations will serve as a strategic partner to Make-A-Wish America and chapter fundraising teams by identifying, researching, qualifying, and prioritizing foundation opportunities that advance wish granting across the country. This role combines prospect research, fundraising strategy, relationship mapping, data integrity, and pipeline management to expand institutional giving opportunities at the national and local levels.

The Manager will dedicate approximately 50% of their time to researching and qualifying family foundations with national giving interests, 25% of their time developing strategies for engagement with the nation’s largest private and philanthropic foundations, and 25% of their time supporting chapter teams in identifying, pursuing, and securing local or regional foundation funding opportunities.

The Manager will bring strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and knowledge of philanthropy, foundation giving trends, prospect research practices, and ethical research standards.

Knowledge and Abilities:

• Demonstrated experience conducting philanthropic, donor, and institutional prospect research.

• Strong understanding of family foundations, private foundations, and institutional philanthropy.

• Ability to analyze complex foundation giving patterns and identify strategic funding opportunities.

• Exceptional project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present research findings and recommendations clearly.

• Experience using fundraising databases, foundation research tools, and CRM platforms.

• Knowledge of prospect management, moves management, pipeline tracking, and fundraising operations best practices.

• Ability to identify relationship pathways among foundation leaders, trustees, advisors, board members, donors, volunteers, staff, and chapter leaders.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with national and chapter fundraising professionals in a remote environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.

• Sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential information.

• Commitment to advancing Make-A-Wish’s mission through data-driven fundraising strategies.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Researches, identifies, and qualifies family foundations with national funding priorities that align with the mission and programs of Make-A-Wish.

• Develops and maintains a strategic portfolio of qualified foundation prospects, including detailed profiles, funding histories, leadership information, and philanthropic interests.

• Monitors foundation trends, giving priorities, and emerging opportunities to inform fundraising strategy and pipeline development.

• Conducts landscape analysis to identify new opportunities within priority funding sectors.

• Partners with national fundraising teams to evaluate and prioritize foundation prospects for cultivation and solicitation strategies.

• Maintains accurate and comprehensive prospect records within Salesforce and other research platforms.

• Tracks prospect stages, recommended next steps, and opportunity movement through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

• Applies qualification criteria to assess foundation fit, capacity, affinity, geography, funding priorities, and likelihood of engagement.

• Develops research briefs, prospect profiles, funding opportunity reports, priority prospect lists, landscape scans, and pipeline dashboards for national and chapter fundraising teams.

• Leads research efforts related to the nation’s largest private and philanthropic foundations, including those with significant endowments and national grantmaking programs.

• Identifies and recommends strategies for engaging top-tier philanthropic institutions whose funding priorities align with Make-A-Wish’s strategic initiatives.

• Conducts relationship mapping to identify potential access points to foundation trustees, staff, advisors, and decision-makers through Make-A-Wish networks.

• Partners with Leadership Gifts team to support development of long-term institutional fundraising strategies.

• Prepares strategic briefing materials and actionable recommendations for frontline fundraisers, chapter leaders, and senior leadership.

• Provides consultative support to chapter fundraising teams by identifying local and regional foundation opportunities.

• Assists chapters in evaluating funding fit, researching foundation priorities, and developing prospect strategies.

• Creates and distributes foundation prospecting resources, training materials, and best practices for chapter teams.

• Collaborates with National and chapter colleagues to strengthen enterprise-wide foundation fundraising efforts.

• Generates routine reports to measure prospect pipeline growth, qualification activity, and funding opportunity outcomes.

• Uses pipeline and qualification data to support forecasting and strategic decision-making.

• Maintains high standards of confidentiality, ethical prospect research, data accuracy, and appropriate use of research tools and information sources.

• Performs other related duties as assigned in support of Foundation relations and broader organizational goals.

Qualifications:

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Nonprofit Management, Philanthropy, Business, Communications, Research, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in fundraising, institutional giving, prospect research, foundation relations, or a related discipline.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

• Ability to synthesize complex information into actionable fundraising recommendations.

• Commitment to mission-driven fundraising and high-quality research practices.

• Ability to work independently and thrive in a remote-first, collaborative environment.

Preferred

• Experience supporting prospect management, moves management, portfolio review, pipeline reporting, or fundraising strategy.

• Experience preparing prospect profiles, relationship maps, funder briefs, research reports, or strategic recommendations for fundraising teams.

• Experience working with foundation funding opportunities and grantmaking organizations.

• Experience in a nonprofit organization.

• Familiarity with AI tools, including CoPilot

• Experience with Salesforce, Foundation Director, Instrumentl, DonorSearch, iWave, or similar prospect research tools.

Working Environment:

• Ability to thrive in a remote environment.

• Travel may be required for internal and external meetings, up to 10%.

• May require work outside a traditional Monday – Friday work week, and outside normal business hours. This includes weekends and early evening weeknights.

This Role's Hiring Range

$63,154—$74,299 USD

What We Offer:

Benefits

• Comprehensive benefit package, effective day 1: Medical, Vision*, Dental*, Wellness

• Competitive compensation with annual incentive potential

• Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account Options

• Health Reimbursement Account fully funded by Make-A-Wish America

• Short Term Disability*, Long Term Disability* and Life Insurance

• Additional Insurance Plans: Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance through Figo

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 5% match after one year of service

• Eligibility for student loan forgiveness through the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program

• The organization will send a laptop, 24” monitor, and a docking station/adaptor to new hires

Time Off

• Competitive PTO starting at 15 days, with enhanced time off for senior roles

• 10 Sick Days

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 2 Volunteer Days after one year of service

• 2 Personal Days accrued annually

• Parental Leave

Also...

• Employee Awards and Recognition Programs

• Individual and Leadership Development

• Discounts and special offers for theme parks, events, hotels, concerts, and movie tickets

• Monthly premiums paid for the employee for vision, dental, and short/long term disability.

We are committed to creating an accessible and inclusive workplace. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the application process, please email hr@wish.org. We are happy to review your needs.

jobs.title: Manager, Talent & Culture
jobs.description:
Manager, Talent & culture

Who We Are:
Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.

The Role:

Atlas Energy Solutions is looking for a Manager, Talent & Culture to lead enterprise talent management, performance management, employee experience, and leadership development programs. This role will build scalable people programs that support our growth, strengthen leadership capability, and help create a high-performance culture.

You’ll partner closely with HR Partners and business leaders to turn business priorities into practical talent strategies, using data and employee insights to improve engagement, retention, development, and organizational effectiveness.

Talent Management & Succession Planning

• Experience managing employee engagement surveys and translating results into actionable insights.

• Strong project management, analytical, and program execution capabilities.

• Experience leveraging HRIS, learning management systems, and employee listening platforms.

• Experience supporting a growing, multi-site, industrial, manufacturing, or operationally intensive organization preferred.

Key Success Measures

• Leadership development participation, effectiveness, and demonstrated capability improvement.

What You Will Love About Us

jobs.title: Label Machine Operator - Nights **$500 Sign-On Bonus**
jobs.description:
Vestcom is a standalone business unit of Avery Dennison, a Fortune 500 leader in materials science and packaging materials.  Learn more at www.vestcom.com.

This role will be D Shift, WED 12AM-6AM, THUR-SAT 6PM-6AM

Starting Hiring Rate: $20-21/hr

**$500 Sign-On Bonus**

Join Avery Dennison as a Label Machine Operator, where you will take ownership of advanced labeling technology to deliver high-quality products. We are looking for a mechanically inclined "Technical Pilot" who is accountable, curious about how equipment functions, and thrives in a performance-driven environment.

What You’ll Do

• Performance & Accuracy: Operate label machines efficiently to meet daily production deadlines while minimizing material waste.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer On-Site, you will serve as the main point of contact between Traba's workforce and our client's on-site leadership team. You'll provide dedicated operational oversight to drive service delivery and act as the face of Traba inside the facility — managing day-to-day worker support, coordinating onboarding and scheduling, and ensuring smooth communication between workers, site supervisors, and Traba's internal operations team.

This role requires professionalism, strong communication, and the ability to build strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced warehouse / manufacturing environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Worker & Client Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with site supervisors and workers, ensuring both receive timely updates, feedback, and support. Serve as the primary relationship owner with supervisors and key points of contact at the facility.

 - On-Site Coordination: Facilitate worker onboarding, introductions, and first-day check-ins; coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires (e.g., forklift operators). Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end.

 - Worker Support & Performance: Assist workers with clock-ins, pay questions, and performance feedback; manage worker performance on-site and escalate issues to internal teams as needed.

 - Communication & Reporting: Act as the bridge between the client site, Traba Ops, and Worker Support teams — communicating key updates, attendance issues, or staffing changes clearly and professionally.

 - Issue Resolution: Identify and flag worker performance concerns or site challenges early, working proactively to resolve them. Handle incident management and escalations.

 - Operational Execution: Support day-to-day site operations, ensuring adequate staffing coverage and a positive worker experience. Own shift and schedule management, and distribute and manage PPE.

 - Account Growth: Identify and drive wallet expansion opportunities within the account.


REQUIREMENTS

 - High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

 - English required; bilingual (English & Spanish) strongly preferred.

 - 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

 - Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

 - Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with both workers and client stakeholders.

 - Polished and presentable in a customer-facing environment.

 - Warm, friendly, and approachable, with the ability to coach workers and confidently enforce standards.

 - Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

 - Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse environments.

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to attendance, shift completion, and overall account health.

jobs.title: Retail Sales Associate - Part Time
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Cresco Labs is one of the largest public, vertically integrated, multistate operators in the cannabis industry. Our portfolio of in-house cultivated and manufactured brands features some of the highest quality, most awarded and most popular cannabis products in America. With dozens of locations nationwide, our owned and operated Sunnyside® dispensaries provide a welcoming, positive, judgement-free place to shop for anyone at any point on their cannabis journey.

Founded in 2013, Cresco Labs’ mission is to normalize and professionalize cannabis through our passionate employees. As stewards of the cannabis industry, our teams are constantly focused on supporting the needs of our fellow colleagues, consumers, customers, and communities alike. With a focus on Social Equity and Educational Development, our SEEDTM initiative ensures that our company reflects the communities in which we serve, ensuring equal opportunity for all to have the knowledge and resources to work in and own businesses in cannabis.

At Cresco Labs, we aim to revolutionize and lead the nation’s cannabis industry with a focus on quality and consistency of product, and to bring legitimacy to the industry with the highest level of integrity and professionalism.

If you’re interested in joining our mission, click the below links to join our team today!

MISSION STATEMENT

At Cresco, we aim to lead the nation’s cannabis industry with a focus on regulatory compliance, product consistency, and customer satisfaction. Our operations bring legitimacy to the cannabis industry by acting with the highest level of integrity, strictly adhering to regulations, and promoting the clinical efficacy of cannabis. As Cresco grows, we will operate with the same level of professionalism and precision in each new market we move in to.

JOB SUMMARY

The Wellness Advisor of Sunnyside* will be responsible for advising customers (recreational, medicinal and caregivers) in selecting the proper cannabis products for their needs and act as an ambassador of the company’s mission to normalize, professionalize and revolutionize cannabis. You will use your customer service, product knowledge and adherence to state compliance regulations to ensure a best-in-class experience. Wellness Advisors are responsible for the customer lifecycle from check-in to consultation, order fulfillment to checkout. In this role, compliance with applicable state and company regulations will be at the forefront of all tasks.

At Sunnyside, we believe the employee experience is paramount to all. With a strong focus on training, development, diversity and authenticity, our employees experience both personal and professional growth.  As a Wellness Advisor, you will have:

• The opportunity to learn fundamental cannabis product knowledge & industry compliance standards.

• The training to navigate different customer interactions and circumstances.

• A unique sales experience leading with a consultative & personalized approach.

• Experience in a dynamic role that combines problem solving, inventory management, teamwork, technical skills, and customer service!

Our dispensaries are typically open 7 days a week, and we value flexibility to work across opening and closing shifts, as well as weekends and holidays. Part-time schedules will be 15-25 hours a week, and typically based around peak hours.

WHO YOU ARE

• You are energetic, possess strong interpersonal skills and work well with others. Collaboration is key to our team’s success!

• You enjoy people! Consulting our customers, listening to their needs and providing an exceptional experience is vital to achieving customer loyalty.

• You are resilient and agile! You use challenges as opportunities to acquire or master skills!

• You hold yourself to a high level of integrity. In an industry that is highly regulated, we trust in our employee’s commitment to always do the right thing.

CORE JOB DUTIES

• Greet customers, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

• Build customer relationships by asking questions about and listening attentively to customer needs, fostering a welcoming and reassuring environment.

• Assist customers in product selection through education of different cannabis products and their varying impact on the human body.

• Apply effective selling and cross-selling techniques to build baskets.

• Verify proper documentation and ID for customers.

• Assist in verifying the accuracy of orders being dispensed to customers in a timely fashion.

• Label and package customer orders.

• Perform accurate cash handling in the company’s Point of Sale system, following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Maintain accurate records of all dispensary activities including customer records, sales, deliveries and returns in accordance with the state regulatory agency and the standards set by Company.

• Perform routine inventory counts of all products.

• Ensure product stock is organized and meets compliance regulations.

• Assist managers with organizing sales floor merchandise and product displays.

• Ensure security measures and safety compliance in the store according to Company SOPs.

• Assist in keeping the store an organized and clean environment for customers and team

• Escalate any employee or customer issues to management.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND SKILLS

• High School Diploma or equivalent.

• Minimum 1 year experience in customer service; retail or hospitality experience preferred.

• Flexibility to work shifts that may include opening, closing, weekends, and holidays.

• Excellent customer service skills and ability to engage with customers.

• Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical and product-related information in a professional consultative manner.

• Must be able to lift, carry and balance up to 50 pounds (100 pounds with assistance).

In accordance with any local and state compensation laws, the compensation listed is the current estimated range for the position. Final offer details and future compensation may be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to, geographic location, market compensation data, skills, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this please discuss with your recruiter during the interview process.

Pay Range

$17—$17 USD

BENEFITS

Cresco Labs is proud to offer eligible employees a robust offering of benefits including, major medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(K)-match program, FSA/HSA programs, LTD/STD options, life insurance and AD&D.  We also offer eligible employees paid holidays and paid time off.  Other rewards may include annual discretionary bonuses, stock options as well as participation in our employee discount program. Benefits eligibility for permanent positions may vary by full-time or part-time roles, location, or position.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Must be 21 years of age or older to apply

• Must comply with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry

• The company does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role or any other position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship at any time.

Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants: Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.

jobs.title: Senior Web Experience Strategist
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Business Marketing team helps organizations understand, adopt, and get value from OpenAI’s products. We work across product marketing, content, creative, and web to connect what our technology can do with the needs of the people and businesses using it.



About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Web Experience Strategist to shape the customer journey across openai.com http://openai.com. You’ll help audiences ranging from individual developers to large enterprises discover what’s possible, find relevant information, and take the right next step.



You’ll think through the full experience: how people arrive, explore products and use cases, learn through content, and move toward getting started or speaking with OpenAI. You’ll shape how navigation, content, and storytelling connect across the site, including deeper pages and transitions into product and sale-led experiences.



This is a senior individual contributor role focused on audience needs, product understanding, and experience strategy. You’ll partner with Web, Design, Content, Product Marketing to build, test, and improve these journeys.



This role is based in San Francisco and in office three days a week.



In this role, you will:

 - Define audience journeys. Understand visitors’ needs and create paths from discovery and learning through evaluation, adoption, and deployment.

 - Connect the website experience. Shape navigation, information architecture, and connections across products, use cases, stories, and resources, wherever someone enters the site.

 - Guide content and storytelling. Identify what visitors need at each stage and partner with Content and Creative to build understanding as people explore deeper.

 - Connect self-service and human support. Make it easy to explore independently, get started, or reach the right OpenAI team when a conversation would help.

 - Turn strategy into shipped work. Create journey maps, experience briefs, and rough wireframes. Partner with Web on a long-term roadmap and stay involved through delivery.

 - Improve journeys over time. Use research, visitor behavior, and experimentation to find gaps and measure whether people can understand their options and take useful next steps.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 10+ years of experience leading web strategy, digital experience, UX, or product strategy, either in-house at a technology company, relevant agency and/or consultancy.

 - Have shaped and improved complex websites, preferably for B2B technology companies, serving multiple products and audiences, with a portfolio that explains your decisions and contribution.

 - Bring strong product judgment and can connect technical capabilities to audience needs, practical use cases, and adoption paths.

 - Have experience in customer journeys, information architecture, navigation, and content strategy, including how storytelling works across a complete experience.

 - Understand when self-service helps customers move forward and when a go-to-market conversation adds value.

We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it’s why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let’s build the future together.

About the Role
The DevOps Team focuses on improving the telemetry around and availability of Abacus' product offerings while contributing to the sustainability of engineering practice throughout the organization. As the "engineers behind the engineers," we are responsible for a diverse set of tasks from across the DevOps spectrum. We work in many contexts, using many tools and technologies to remove obstacles and keep the rest of the engineering organization moving as efficiently and effectively as possible. We are a small, nimble team making an outsized impact.
Your day to day

• Build and maintain secure, scalable, HIPAA- and HITRUST-compliant infrastructure on multiple cloud platforms (AWS and Azure)

• Design, implement, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure

• Contribute to DevOps architecture best practices and help shape our approach to CI/CD and infrastructure as code (IaC)

• Collaborate with engineering, product, and security teams to design robust infrastructure solutions

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Python-based scripts to automate testing, validation, and deployment workflows

• Build and manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, and self-hosted)

• Implement monitoring and observability using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk

• Support the design, implementation, and adoption of our custom Python- and Cloud-based deployment platform with an eye toward continuous delivery

• Promote best practices both within the team and within the larger organization

What you bring to the team

• 4+ years of development experience, including work on complex systems

• Strong cloud experience, AWS preferred

• Solid understanding of Linux systems administration and networking

• Experience implementing a CI/CD system using an industry-standard platform such as GitLab, Jenkins, or Travis

• Knowledge of containerization, specifically Docker and Kubernetes

• Fluent command of the tools of the trade, including Bash, Python, or Terraform

• Knowledge of best practices as related to designing and building efficient, maintainable, testable, portable applications

• Keen attention to detail

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG — the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.



THE ROLE

Data at Confido feeds customer-facing reports, internal dashboards, and a lot of day-to-day decisions. Right now it lives in too many places and is owned by too many people. We're hiring a Data Engineering Manager to fix that and to build the team that keeps it fixed.

You'll manage our Senior Analytics Engineer to start, and you'll hire as the team grows. For the first stretch you'll write a good amount of code yourself. Later, more of your time will go to hiring, planning, and working with other teams.



What You'll Do

 - Manage and develop the data team, starting with our Senior Analytics Engineer.

 - Decide what the team works on and in what order, and explain those calls to the rest of the company.

 - Make the big technical decisions on warehouse design, pipelines, orchestration, and tooling.

 - Hire data engineers as we grow. You'll write the job descriptions, run the interviews, and onboard new hires.

 - Set standards for modeling, testing, docs, monitoring, and on-call.

 - Work with Engineering, Product, Ops, and Customer teams to agree on metric definitions and figure out what data they actually need.

 - Be accountable when numbers are wrong or pipelines break, and put fixes in place so the same problems don't come back.

 - Write SQL, build models, and review PRs, especially early on.



What We're Looking For

 - 7+ years in data or analytics engineering, with at least 2 years managing engineers.

 - You've built a data warehouse from an early or messy state before, and you've kept it running afterward.

 - Strong SQL and data modeling skills. You've built and maintained ETL/ELT pipelines in production.

 - Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar tools.

 - You've hired engineers and helped them get better at their jobs.

 - You can take a vague request like "we need better reporting," figure out what's really needed, and turn it into a plan.

 - You're happy splitting your time between managing and building.



Success in This Role

A year in, people across Confido trust the data and know where to find it. There's one set of core models the whole company uses, pipelines break less often, and when they do break, someone notices before a customer does. The team is bigger than one person, and it has clear standards that new hires can pick up quickly.




🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

 - Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

 - Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums

 - Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

 - Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support

 - 12 weeks of paid parental leave

 - Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take

 - 401(k) through Vestwell

 - Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC

 - Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup

 - Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with
