jobs.title: Project Manager, Laser (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.


YOUR ROLE

As a Project Manager supporting the Laser team, you will drive alignment across complex, multi-partner projects within our laser and optical component development programs. You will be responsible for collaborative projects with external partners from academia and industry. You will also help to establishand strengthen internal project management standards across Focused Energy and the Laser organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage external research and development projects in collaboration with public and private partners, from proposal or kickoff through execution, reporting, and close-out

 - Develop and execute the development strategy for optical and laser components with stakeholders across laser leadership, technical project teams, finance, and business development

 - Drive structured program and project planning, status tracking, meeting cadences, action follow-up, and transparent communication across a complex, multi-project environment

 - Support proposals and execution of publicly funded projects by maintaining reporting discipline, and ensuring alignment with partner and funding requirements

 - Align and report on program and project status to for both division and enterprise-level stakeholders

 - Collaborate closely with scientists and engineering teams, building technical depth to understand dependencies, challenge assumptions, and help remove execution roadblocks

 - Contribute to establishing and improving internal project management standards, tools, and best practices within the Laser organization and beyond

 - Coordinate with company-wide PM efforts to ensure compliance with broader Focused Energy project management practices

 - Represent Focused Energy with external partners (institutional, industrial, funding agency); expect regular travel within Germany (approximately 6 trips per year)


WHO YOU ARE


MUST-HAVES

 - Excellent degree in STEM or a related field (engineering, physics, natural sciences, or another STEM discipline)

 - Outstanding track record (e.g., academic performance, honors, competitive scholarships, or equivalent achievements in research, engineering, or personal projects)

 - Experience managing projects or workstreams in technically complex environments, with the ability to structure plans, milestones, risks, decisions, and reporting across multiple parallel topics

 - Ability to operate successfully in a complex multi-project environment with many stakeholders and dependencies, including the ability to prioritize and optimize processes

 - Confidence working with project management tools, documentation, and structured follow-up

 - High affinity for close collaboration with scientists and engineering teams, paired with curiosity and willingness to dive into new topics

 - Strong problem-solving attitude, ownership mindset, and structured way of working

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence in stakeholder management across technical and non-technical interfaces, in both German and English


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience in publicly funded research or development projects

 - Exposure to project management standards, processes, or PMO build-up activities

 - Experience working with external research, industrial, or ecosystem partners

 - Interest in laser technology, advanced engineering, or fusion-related development

 - Experience with project management tools such as Jira or MS Project


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 - Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

 - Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.title: Manager, Client Delivery
jobs.description:
ABOUT GMR MARKETING

We are the Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity

NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL. EXPERIENCE.

The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.

NOT JUST TELLING. MAKING.

The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they’ll never forget.

NOT JUST CONSUMERS. HUMANS.

It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

As our Manager, Client Delivery you will work closely with the Sr. Director to support the planning, execution, and success of domestic and international corporate hospitality and experiential programs. You will play a key role in managing the tactical and operational details of high-touch programs, collaborating with clients, internal teams, and external partners to deliver exceptional experiences across complex, multi-market engagements.

To thrive in this position, you are an experienced hospitality and experiential professional with a strong understanding of sponsorship asset utilization and high-value corporate guest experiences. You have exceptional time management and organizational skills, strong client service acumen, and the ability to troubleshoot and make sound decisions in fast-paced, high-pressure environments. You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and timelines simultaneously and are motivated by delivering seamless experiences where no detail is overlooked.

TEAM DESCRIPTION

At GMR, we fully immerse ourselves in our clients' brand DNA, leveraging decades of unparalleled global event expertise across elite platforms—including the Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA World Cups, the Super Bowl, Ryder Cup, Wimbledon, and Formula 1. We successfully navigate highly complex, high-stakes corporate ecosystems to engineer best-in-class, transformative experiences that elevate our clients on the world stage.

Our team produces unique, once-in-a-lifetime moments for high-value target audiences, driven by a culture of disruptive fresh thinking and meticulous operational discipline. Operating within a rapid, high-pressure, and constantly evolving environment, we consistently deliver exceptional, tier-one results. No detail is overlooked. Bound by a collective commitment to shared success, we champion a highly collaborative and supportive culture where team members seamlessly unite to achieve the extraordinary.

Preference will be given to candidates based in or around the Greater Los Angeles area, given the strategic positioning and multi-year planning requirements associated with upcoming marquee engagements and the LA 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

ABOUT GMR MARKETING

We are the Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity

NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL. EXPERIENCE.

The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.

NOT JUST TELLING. MAKING.

The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they’ll never forget.

NOT JUST CONSUMERS. HUMANS.

It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Hospitality & Program Execution. You have proven experience planning and executing high-touch corporate hospitality programs across domestic and international markets. You are comfortable managing accommodations, accreditation, transportation, ticketing, hospitality venues, food and beverage, entertainment, gifting, staffing, guest communications, and other operational details across complex and overlapping timelines.

• Client Leadership. You build trusted relationships with clients and are comfortable engaging with senior-level stakeholders. You can provide thoughtful recommendations, develop executive-level presentations and communications, and ensure program execution aligns with client objectives, brand positioning, and broader sponsorship strategies.

• Sponsorship Expertise. You have a sophisticated understanding of sponsorship platforms and high-value asset utilization. You are able to translate sponsorship rights and assets into meaningful hospitality and guest experiences while identifying opportunities to maximize program impact.

• Financial & Operational Management. You bring strong financial acumen and organizational skills, with experience managing budgets across markets and currencies, forecasting, tracking expenses, reconciling invoices, and maintaining clear reporting. You’re highly organized, able to manage competing priorities and detailed workback schedules, and understand how individual deliverables contribute to the success of the broader program.

• Ability to Prioritize. You are highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, and deadlines simultaneously. You maintain detailed timelines, workback schedules, and action items while understanding how individual deliverables can impact the broader program lifecycle.

• Problem Solving & Adaptability. You’re resourceful, solutions oriented, and comfortable operating in fast paced environments where priorities can shift. You know how to assess challenges quickly, make sound decisions, and keep programs on track without losing sight of the details.

• Leadership & Collaboration. You work well independently and as part of a collaborative team. You’re comfortable mentoring team members, coordinating cross functional partners, leading onsite staff, and managing vendors and suppliers to ensure strong service delivery and seamless guest experiences.

• Execution Excellence. You have a high bar for quality and a genuine appreciation for the details that make an experience exceptional. You stay calm under pressure, maintain strong standards throughout execution, and take pride in delivering polished, memorable experiences for high value audiences.

• Industry Knowledge & Technical Skills. You stay curious about trends across hospitality, events, sponsorship, and guest experience and look for new ways to improve programs. You’re highly proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and comfortable using project management and other technology platforms to keep work organized.

• Experience & Global Mobility. You bring experience managing high-value corporate hospitality programs, sponsorship assets, guest experiences, or comparable premium events. You are open and able to travel domestically and internationally for site inspections, client meetings, and onsite program execution. You understand that this role may require extended periods of travel, remote work from host cities, and flexible availability during nights, weekends, and holiday

The annual range for this role varies between $80,000- $105,000 and may vary depending on the candidate’s experience. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401k, employee stock purchase plan, vacation, personal days and paid holiday time. You are also eligible to participate in disability, life insurance, FSA/HSA plans subject to the terms and conditions of such benefit plans.

IMPACT & INCLUSION

Our workplace is for ALL. We foster a culture where every background and perspective is valued so we can create meaningful memories that resonate with everyone. We aim to cultivate belonging by meeting people where they are, removing obstacles, and building on their strengths to unlock their fullest contributions. We are committed to recognizing, nurturing, and unleashing the potential in every individual on our team. Together, we're creating something powerful with purpose and impact.

Our guiding principles can be found here.
